Las dos escalas temporales dispares se entrecruzan ocasionalmente —tanto en las disrupciones auríferas del siglo XIX como en los terremotos del siglo XX—, y siempre con relevancia para una historia geológica recién comprendida, en la que se observa que media docena de grandes y separadas regiones del país se desplazaron desde lugares lejanos y cercanos para fusionarse en California. McPhee y Moores también viajaron a remotas montañas de Arizona, Chipre y el norte de Grecia, donde la roca del fondo oceánico se ha transportado a entornos continentales, como en California. De alcance global y un deleite para leer, Assembling California es una narrativa panorámica de mapas en movimiento, de tierras que evolucionan y se disuelven.

But as hysteria and depravity increase, it becomes clear that it is not the Messiah who has come to Goray.

title: The Stories (So Far) of Deborah Eisenberg
description: When Deborah Eisenberg's first book of stories, Transactions in a Foreign Currency, was published, John Updike noted: "Whenever a new writer arrives, a new window of life is opened, and this has happened here." The scope and depth of Eisenberg's idiosyncratic vision were even more apparent in her second collection, Under the 82nd Airborne, which The New York Times Book Review called "nothing short of extraordinary." As these two collections gathered here into one volume show, Eisenberg's stories have an astonishing power and range. Her characters, whether they are walking in the streets of Manhattan or seemingly abandoned in foreign countries, continually make disquieting and sometimes life-threatening discoveries about themselves, discoveries that illuminate not only their own lives but also the wider net of relationships in which they are enmeshed.

title: The Magic Barrel
description: Winner of the National Book Award for Fiction Introduction by Jhumpa Lahiri Bernard Malamud's first book of short stories, The Magic Barrel, has been recognized as a classic from the time it was published in 1959. The stories are set in New York and in Italy (where Malamud's alter ego, the struggleing New York Jewish Painter Arthur Fidelman, roams amid the ruins of old Europe in search of his artistic patrimony); they tell of egg candlers and shoemakers, matchmakers, and rabbis, in a voice that blends vigorous urban realism, Yiddish idiom, and a dash of artistic magic. The Magic Barrel is a book about New York and about the immigrant experience, and it is high point in the modern American short story. Few books of any kind have managed to depict struggle and frustration and heartbreak with such delight, or such artistry.

title: The Eclogues of Virgil
description: Virgil's great lyrics, rendered by the acclaimed translator of The Odes of Horace and Gilgamesh The Eclogues of Virgil gave definitive form to the pastoral mode, and these magically beautiful poems, which were influential in so much subsequent literature, perhaps best exemplify what pastoral can do. "Song replying to song replying to song," touchingly comic, poignantly sad, sublimely joyful, the various music that these shepherds make echoes in scenes of repose and harmony, and of hardship and trouble in work and love. A bilingual edition, The Eclogues of Virgil includes concise, informative notes and an Introduction that describes the fundamental role of this deeply original book in the pastoral tradition.

title: Memoirs of Hadrian
description: Both an exploration of character and a reflection on the meaning of history, Memoirs of Hadrian has received international acclaim since its first publication in France in 1951. In it, Marguerite Yourcenar reimagines the Emperor Hadrian's arduous boyhood, his triumphs and reversals, and finally, as emperor, his gradual reordering of a war-torn world, writing with the imaginative insight of a great writer of the twentieth century while crafting a prose style as elegant and precise as those of the Latin stylists of Hadrian's own era.

title: Play It As It Lays
description: A ruthless dissection of American life in the late 1960s, Play It as It Lays captures the mood of an entire generation, the ennui of contemporary society reflected in spare prose that blisters and haunts the reader. Set in a place beyond good and evil-literally in Hollywood, Las Vegas, and the barren wastes of the Mojave Desert, but figuratively in the landscape of an arid soul-it remains more than three decades after its original publication a profoundly disturbing novel, riveting in its exploration of a woman and a society in crisis and stunning in the still-startling intensity of its prose.

title: Gimpel the Fool
description: Isaac Bashevis Singer's first collection of stories, Gimpel the Fool, is a landmark work that has attracted international acclaim since it was first published in 1957. In Saul Bellow's masterly translation, the title story follows the exploits of Gimpel, an ingenuous baker who is universally deceived but who declines to retaliate against his tormentors. Gimpel and the protagonists of the other stories in this volume all inhabit the distinctive pre-World War II ghettos of Poland and, beyond that, the larger world created by Singer's unforgettable prose.

title: Georgics (Zongo Classics)
description: The Georgics is a poem by Latin poet Virgil, likely published in 29 BC. As the name suggests (from the Greek word γεωργικά, geōrgika, i.e. "agricultural (things)") the subject of the poem is agriculture; but far from being an example of peaceful rural poetry, it is a work characterized by tensions in both theme and purpose. The Georgics is considered Virgil's second major work, following his Eclogues and preceding the Aeneid. The poem draws on a variety of prior sources,[citation needed] and has influenced many later authors from antiquity to the present.

title: Sophie's World
description: A page-turning novel that is also an exploration of the great philosophical concepts of Western thought, Sophie's World has fired the imagination of readers all over the world, with more than twenty million copies in print. One day fourteen-year-old Sophie Amundsen comes home from school to find in her mailbox two notes, with one question on each: "Who are you?" and "Where does the world come from?" From that irresistible beginning, Sophie becomes obsessed with questions that take her far beyond what she knows of her Norwegian village. Through those letters, she enrolls in a kind of correspondence course, covering Socrates to Sartre, with a mysterious philosopher, while receiving letters addressed to another girl. Who is Hilde? And why does her mail keep turning up? To unravel this riddle, Sophie must use the philosophy she is learning--but the truth turns out to be far more complicated than she could have imagined.

title: Essays
description: Presents a collection of essays from George Orwell, including his discussion of pacifism, "My Country Right or Left," his scathingly complicated views on the dirty work of imperialism in "Shooting an Elephant," and his very firm opinion on how to make "ANice Cup of Tea."

title: On Late Style
description: A collection of essays by the late cultural critic explores great works of music and literature produced by Beethoven, Schoenberg, Mann, Cavafy, Beckett, Gould, Straus, Genet, and others at the end of their creative lives, analyzing how these works differed from previous ones and what they reveal about each musician's or writer's artistic evolution. 15,000 first printing.

spanish_description: Una colección de ensayos del difunto crítico cultural explora grandes obras de música y literatura producidas por Beethoven, Schoenberg, Mann, Cavafis, Beckett, Gould, Straus, Genet y otros al final de sus vidas creativas, analizando cómo estas obras diferían de las anteriores y qué revelan sobre la evolución artística de cada músico o escritor. 15.000 primera impresión.

title: The Good Husband of Zebra Drive
description: Handling a busy case load at The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency and contending with an intruder in her home, Mma Ramotswe has plenty on her mind. So when her unfortunate past returns to haunt her, she is happy her husband, Mr. J.L.B. Matekoni, is distracted as well. It seems one of his apprentices at Tlokweng Road Speedy Motors has raced off with an older, wealthy woman.

Parece que uno de sus aprendices en Tlokweng Road Speedy Motors se ha fugado con una mujer mayor y adinerada.

spanish_description: En el cuarto volumen de su autobiografía, la autora describe sus experiencias como cantante-bailarina en Nueva York y sus impresiones del movimiento por los Derechos Civiles.

title: In Cold Blood

Reedición. Primera tirada de 10.000 ejemplares.

title: Shakespeare's Kitchen
description: A noted food historian brings to life the classic foods of William Shakepeare's world in a series of updated, easy-to-prepare recipes, drawn from sixteenth- and seventeenth-century cookbooks, for a variety of tasty dishes that include Grilled Tuna with Carrots and Sweet Onions, Fish Bisque with Chestnuts and Artichokes, and Red Snapper with Caviar, among others. 35,000 first printing.
title_and_subtitle: Shakespeare's Kitchen: Renaissance Recipes for the Contemporary Cook
tagged_description: 9780375509179 A noted food historian brings to life the classic foods of William Shakepeare's world in a series of updated, easy-to-prepare recipes, drawn from sixteenth- and seventeenth-century cookbooks, for a variety of tasty dishes that include Grilled Tuna with Carrots and Sweet Onions, Fish Bisque with Chestnuts and Artichokes, and Red Snapper with Caviar, among others. 35,000 first printing.

Primera impresión de 35.000.

title: As She Climbed Across the Table
description: Deeply in love with physicist Alice Coombs, professor Philip Engstrand becomes involved in Alice's research into the creation of "Lack," a conscious void in the universe that swallows up things it fancies

title: Evening
description: Now ailing and surrounded by her children, sixty-five-year-old Ann Grant Lord reminisces about a glorious summer weekend some forty years earlier during which she met and lost the love of her life. By the author of Folly. 100,000 first printing. Tour.

title: The Executioner's Song
description: Reconstructs the crime and fate of Gary Gilmore, the convicted murderer who sought his own execution in Utah, based on taped interviews with relatives, friends, lawyers, and law-enforcement officials.
tagged_description: 9780375700811 Reconstructs the crime and fate of Gary Gilmore, the convicted murderer who sought his own execution in Utah, based on taped interviews with relatives, friends, lawyers, and law-enforcement officials.

title: Night Falls Fast
description: A study of the growing epidemic of suicide among young people draws on the author's firsthand battle with severe manic-depression and attempted suicide to reveal the psychological, medical, and biological aspects of self-inflicted death.
tagged_description: 9780375701474 A study of the growing epidemic of suicide among young people draws on the author's firsthand battle with severe manic-depression and attempted suicide to reveal the psychological, medical, and biological aspects of self-inflicted death.
spanish_description: Un estudio de la creciente epidemia de suicidio entre los jóvenes se basa en la batalla directa del autor con la depresión maníaca severa y el intento de suicidio para revelar los aspectos psicológicos, médicos y biológicos de la muerte autoinfligida.

title: The Amen Corner

spanish_description: La obra se centra en el dilema de la congregación de una iglesia en Harlem cuando se dan cuenta de que la Hermana Margaret, su líder, no es una santa.

title: Melville
description: A compelling portrait of one of America's leading literary luminaries chronicles the life and career of the quintessentially American author Herman Melville, tracing his life and literary career to uncover autobiographical elements in his diverse works, discussing the historical and cultural implications of his writing, and assessing his accomplishments as a writer. Reprint. 17,500 first printing.

Reimpresión. Primera tirada de 17.500 ejemplares.

title: Maximum City
description: A portrait of Bombay, India, and its people chronicles the everday life of the city and its inhabitants, from the criminal underworld of rival Muslim and Hindu gangs to the diverse people who come from the villages in search of a better life.

title: Glamorama
description: A young man from the fashionable, celebrityobsessed society of New York finds himself gradually drawn into a shadowy, dark side of that society, until he becomes trapped in terrifying world in which politics and family, terrorism and fame become inextricably intertwined. Reprint. 50,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780375703843 A young man from the fashionable, celebrityobsessed society of New York finds himself gradually drawn into a shadowy, dark side of that society, until he becomes trapped in terrifying world in which politics and family, terrorism and fame become inextricably intertwined. Reimpresión. Primera tirada de 50.000 ejemplares.

title: White Teeth
description: Set in post-war London, this novel of the racial, political, and social upheaval of the last half-century follows two families--the Joneses and the Iqbals, both outsiders from within the former British empire--as they make their way in modern England. A first novel. Reprint. 200,000 first printing.

spanish_description: Ambientada en el Londres de posguerra, esta novela sobre la agitación racial, política y social del último medio siglo sigue a dos familias —los Jones y los Iqbal, ambos forasteros del antiguo imperio británico— mientras se abren camino en la Inglaterra moderna. Primera novela. Reimpresión. 200.000 ejemplares.

title: The Autograph Man
description: Autograph trader Alex-Li Tandem embarks on an odyssey that takes him from London to New York in pursuit of the only autograph that has ever really mattered to him, dealing with con men and fellow collectors who would hinder his quest.

title: Sons of Mississippi
description: A study of the dark legacy of racial intolerance and prejudice profiles the lives and fortunes of seven white Mississippi sheriffs, immortalized in a haunting 1962 LIFE magazine photograph, who took part in the violence that resulted from James Meredith's attempt to integrate the University of Mississippi, and it influence on their own lives and the lives of their children and grandchildren. Reprint. 25,000 first printing.

Reimpresión. Primera tirada de 25.000 ejemplares.

title: Founding Brothers
description: The introduction, discussion questions, suggestions for further reading, and author biography that follow are intended to enhance your reading group's discussion of Joseph Ellis's Founding Brothers: The Revolutionary Generation . We hope they will enrich your experience of this Pulitzer Prize-winning study of the intertwined lives of the founders of the American republic--John Adams, Aaron Burr, Benjamin Franklin, Alexander Hamilton, Thomas Jefferson, James Madison, and George Washington.

title: The Tiny One
description: Grieving over the death of her mother, killed in a winter car accident in Massachusetts, young Via Revere copes with her anguish and loss by vividly recalling the events of the day her mother died. A first novel. Reprint. 25,000 first printing.

title: Crucible of War
description: Demonstrating that the decisive "Seven Years' War" changed the balance of power between the British and French in North America, the author argues that this conflict destroyed the delicate balance of power that gave Native people a voice in the affairs of the continent while creating an "American generation." Reprint. 25,00 first printing.

spanish_description: Al demostrar que la decisiva "Guerra de los Siete Años" alteró el equilibrio de poder entre británicos y franceses en Norteamérica, el autor argumenta que este conflicto destruyó el delicado equilibrio de poder que dio voz a los pueblos indígenas en los asuntos del continente, creando al mismo tiempo una "generación estadounidense". Reimpresión. 25,00 primera impresión.

title: No Country for Old Men
description: Stumbling upon a bloody massacre, a cache of heroin, and more than two million in cash during a hunting trip, Llewelyn Moss removes the money, a decision that draws him and his young wife into the middle of a violent confrontation.
tagged_description: 9780375706677 Stumbling upon a bloody massacre, a cache of heroin, and more than two million in cash during a hunting trip, Llewelyn Moss removes the money, a decision that draws him and his young wife into the middle of a violent confrontation.

title: I Married a Communist
description: Ira Ringold, a ditchdigger from Newark, rises to prominence in the 1940s as a radio star and is betrayed by his new wife, silent film star Eve Frame, who reveals his Communist connections during the McCarthy witch hunts of the early 1950s
tagged_description: 9780375707216 Ira Ringold, a ditchdigger from Newark, rises to prominence in the 1940s as a radio star and is betrayed by his new wife, silent film star Eve Frame, who reveals his Communist connections during the McCarthy witch hunts of the early 1950s

title: Lives of Girls and Women
description: A poignant portrayal of a young girl's youth in a Canadian town and her awakening to womanhood in the 1940s follows Del Jordan as she explores the dark and bright sides of womanhood and records the frustrations, joys, triumphs, and trials of small-town life. Reprint. 20,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780375707490 A poignant portrayal of a young girl's youth in a Canadian town and her awakening to womanhood in the 1940s follows Del Jordan as she explores the dark and bright sides of womanhood and records the frustrations, joys, triumphs, and trials of small-town life. Reprint. 20,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Un conmovedor retrato de la juventud de una joven en un pueblo canadiense y su despertar a la feminidad en la década de 1940, sigue a Del Jordan mientras explora los aspectos positivos y negativos de la feminidad y registra las frustraciones, alegrías, triunfos y dificultades de la vida en un pueblo pequeño. Reimpresión. Primera tirada de 20.000 ejemplares.

title: The Working Poor
description: An intimate portrait of poverty-level working families from a range of ethnic backgrounds in America reveals their legacy of low-paying, dead-end jobs, dysfunctional parenting, and substance abuse and charges the government with failing to provide adequate housing, health care, and education. Reprint. 40,000 first printing.
title_and_subtitle: The Working Poor: Invisible In America

Reprint. 40,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Un retrato íntimo de familias trabajadoras en situación de pobreza, provenientes de diversos orígenes étnicos, en Estados Unidos revela su legado de empleos precarios y sin futuro, crianza disfuncional y abuso de sustancias, y acusa al gobierno de no proporcionar vivienda, atención médica ni educación adecuadas. Reimpresión. Primera tirada de 40.000 ejemplares.

title: Masters of Death
description: The Pulitzer Prize-winning historian challenges traditional interpretations of the Holocaust in a study that describes the role of the Einsatzgruppen, task forces deployed in Eastern Europe by the SS, whose job was to slaughter Eastern European Jews, the development of less personalized means of murder, and Hitler's eventual plans to annihilate members of other ethnic groups. Reprint.
title_and_subtitle: Masters of Death: The Ss-Einsatzgruppen and the Invention of the Holocaust
tagged_description: 9780375708220 The Pulitzer Prize-winning historian challenges traditional interpretations of the Holocaust in a study that describes the role of the Einsatzgruppen, task forces deployed in Eastern Europe by the SS, whose job was to slaughter Eastern European Jews, the development of less personalized means of murder, and Hitler's eventual plans to annihilate members of other ethnic groups. Reprint.
spanish_description: El historiador ganador del Premio Pulitzer desafía las interpretaciones tradicionales del Holocausto en un estudio que describe el papel de los Einsatzgruppen, grupos de trabajo desplegados en Europa del Este por las SS, cuya misión era masacrar a los judíos de Europa del Este; el desarrollo de métodos de asesinato menos personalizados; y los planes finales de Hitler para aniquilar a miembros de otros grupos étnicos. Reimpresión.

title: De Kooning

title: Geek Love

title: John James Audubon

Reprint.

title: Julian

title: Lunar Park

title: Salonica, City of Ghosts

title: The Waste Land and Other Writings
description: First published in 1922, "The Waste Land" is T.S. Eliot's masterpiece, and is not only one of the key works of modernism but also one of the greatest poetic achievements of the twentieth century. A richly allusive pilgrimage of spiritual and psychological torment and redemption, Eliot's poem exerted a revolutionary influence on his contemporaries, summoning forth a rich new poetic language, breaking decisively with Romantic and Victorian poetic traditions. Kenneth Rexroth was not alone in calling Eliot "the representative poet of the time, for the same reason that Shakespeare and Pope were of theirs. He articulated the mind of an epoch in words that seemed its most natural expression." As influential as his verse, T.S. Eliot's criticism also exerted a transformative effect on twentieth-century letter, and this new edition of The Waste Land and Other Writings includes a selection of Eliot's most important essays. In her new Introduction, Mary Karr dispels some of the myths of the great poem's inaccessibility and sheds fresh light on the ways in which "The Waste Land" illuminates contemporary experience. From the Hardcover edition.

description: Behold the Handwriting of God Astrophysicist and adventurer George Smoot spent twenty years pursuing the "holy grail of science" -- a relentless hunt that led him from the rain forests of Brazil to the frozen wastes of Antarctica. For decades he persevered -- struggling against time, the elements, the forces of ignorance and bureaucratic insanity. And finally, on April 23, 1992, he made a startling announcement that would usher in a new scientific age. For George Smoot and his dedicated team of Berkeley researchers had proven the unprovable -- uncovering, inarguably and for all time, the secrets of the creation of the Universe.

title: The Death of an Irish Sea Wolf
description: In a remote community off the west coast of Ireland, residents inclined to gossip speculate why reclusive Clement Ford, the "Sea Wolf," has become such a generous benefactor to his neighbors. then one night, a mysterious figure from Ford's past arrives on the island, and by morning three people are murdered and Ford has disappeared. And what does he have that is worth killing so many people for?

title: Notes from a Small Island
description: "Suddenly, in the space of a moment, I realized what it was that I loved about Britain-which is to say, all of it." After nearly two decades spent on British soil, Bill Bryson-bestsellingauthor of The Mother Tongue and Made in America-decided to returnto the United States. ("I had recently read," Bryson writes, "that 3.7 million Americans believed that they had been abducted by aliens at one time or another,so it was clear that my people needed me.") But before departing, he set out ona grand farewell tour of the green and kindly island that had so long been his home. Veering from the ludicrous to the endearing and back again, Notes from a Small Island is a delightfully irreverent jaunt around the unparalleled floating nation that has produced zebra crossings, Shakespeare, Twiggie Winkie's Farm, and places with names like Farleigh Wallop and Titsey. The result is an uproarious social commentary that conveys the true glory of Britain, from the satiric pen of an unapologetic Anglophile. title: Summer of the Dragon
description: A good salary and an all-expenses-paid summer spent a sprawling Arizona ranch is too good a deal for fledgling anthropologist D.J. Abbott to turn down. What does it matter that her rich new employer/benefactor, Hank Hunnicutt, is a certified oddball who is presently funding all manner of off-beat projects, from alien conspiracy studies to a hunt for dragon bones? There's even talk of treasure buried in the nearby mountains, but D.J. isn't going to allow loose speculation -- or the considerable charms of handsome professional treasure hunter Jesse Franklin -- to sidetrack her. Until Hunnicutt suffers a mysterious accident and then vanishes, leaving the weirdos gathered at his spread to eye each other with frightened suspicion. But on a high desert search for the missing millionaire, D.J. is learning things that may not be healthy for her to know. For the game someone is playing here goes far beyond the rational universe -- and it could leave D.J. legitimately dead.

Adam is immediately captivated by Sophia's heated sensuality, which sears through his cool reserve and makes him forget his duty. As for Sophia, she is powerless to resist his intense masculinity and air of mystery. Rebelling against her impending marriage, Sophia willfully surrenders herself body and soul to Adam's intense passion...only to discover that the price of forbidden love could be her life.

title: Only Mine
description: Whether she′s creating incomparable love stories of passion and redemption or breathtaking tales of romantic suspense, there is simply no finer storyteller at work today than the phenomenal New York Times bestseller Elizabeth Lowell. The bastard son of a viscount and a Cheyenne shaman′s daughter, Wolfe Lonetree agrees to rescue the pampered Lady Jessica from an unwanted impending wedding -- but only if she will be his wife. Naive and shockingly innocent, Lady Jessica Charteris tricked a rugged, handsome stranger into a marriage in name only in order to escape a union with a vile British lord. Totally unprepared for the hardships awaiting her in America, she is terrified by the prospect of life in the harsh and magnificent land at the edge of the Rockies. But even more frightening is Wolfe himself -- a man whose raw sensuality leaves her breathless. Her proud, virile new "husband" is not one to be trifled with, nor will he be denied what his heart fervently desires -- for only in Wolfe Lonetree′s arms can Jessica truly learn the unparalleled joy of becoming the right man′s woman.

Pero aún más aterrador es el propio Wolfe, un hombre cuya cruda sensualidad la deja sin aliento. Su nuevo y orgulloso "marido" viril no es alguien con quien se pueda jugar, ni se le negará lo que su corazón desea fervientemente, pues sólo en los brazos de Wolfe Lonetree Jessica puede aprender verdaderamente la alegría incomparable de convertirse en la mujer del hombre adecuado.

title: Smoke and Mirrors
description: In the deft hands of Neil Gaiman, magic is no mere illusion ... and anything is possible. In this, Gaiman's first book of short stories, his imagination and supreme artistry transform a mundane world into a place of terrible wonders -- a place where an old woman can purchase the Holy Grail at a thrift store, where assassins advertise their services in the Yellow Pages under "Pest Control," and where a frightened young boy must barter for his life with a mean-spirited troll living beneath a bridge by the railroad tracks. Explore a new reality -- obscured by smoke and darkness, yet brilliantly tangible -- in this extraordinary collection of short works by a master prestidigitator. It will dazzle your senses, touch your heart, and haunt your dreams.

title: Shards of a Broken Crown
description: The demon is no more. The enemy has been routed. But all is not well . . . Winter's icy grasp is loosening on the world. The Emerald Queen's vanquished army has its broken back to the Bitter Sea. And treachery is its only recourse. A lackey has declared himself Lord of the defeated, amassing the still fearsome remnants of a ruthless fighting force together for one final assault on a weakened, vulnerable realm. For the warriors who remained steadfast against terrible numbers, for the courageous souls who barely survived a devastating onslaught upon their homeland, the time to rebuild and renew has not yet come. The war is not over in Midkemia. And Jimmy and Dash—two young noble brothers who stand at the center of a gathering storm—are impelled to action that could secure a tenuous peace . . . or turn triumph into catastrophe. The demon is no more. The enemy has been routed. But all is not well . . .

title: Regarding the Fountain
description: The Dry Creek Middle School drinking fountain has sprung a leak, so principal Walter Russ dashes off a request to Flowing Waters Fountains, Etc. ...We need a new drinking fountain. Please send a catalog. Designer Flo Waters responds: "I'd be delighted...but please understand that all of my fountains are custom-made." Soon the fountain project takes on a life of its own, one chronicled in letters, postcards, memos, transcripts, and official documents. The school board president is up in arms. So is Dee Eel, of the water-supply company. A scandal is brewing, and Mr. Sam N.'s fifth grade class is turning up a host of hilarious secrets buried deep beneath the fountain.

title: What Looks Like Crazy On an Ordinary Day
description: In a remarkable debut novel that sizzles with sensuality, crackles with life-affirming energy and moves the reader to laughter and tears, author Pearl Cleage creates a world rich in character, human drama, and deep, compassionate understanding. After a decade of luxe living in Atlanta, Ava Johnson has returned to tiny Idlewild, Michigan -- her fabulous career and power plans smashed to bits on one dark truth: Ava has tested positive for HIV. Bur rather than a sorrowful end, her homecoming is a new beginning. Because, in the ten-plus years since she left, all the problems of the big city have invaded the sleepy community of her childhood. Because dear friends and family sorely need her help in the face of impending trouble and tragedy, and Ava cannot turn her back on them. And because, most importantly, Ava Johnson is inexplicabley and undeniably falling in love.

Porque, en los más de diez años transcurridos desde su partida, todos los problemas de la gran ciudad han invadido la soñolienta comunidad de su infancia. Porque sus queridos amigos y familiares necesitan urgentemente su ayuda ante los problemas y la tragedia inminentes, y Ava no puede darles la espalda. Y porque, lo más importante, Ava Johnson se está enamorando inexplicablemente.

title: Exile's Return
description: Saved by a mage's intervention from certain death, Kaspar, the evil Duke of Olasko, is lord no more -- reduced to an exile's existence and forced to wander the harshest realms of the world he once enslaved. Merciless deserts, forbidding mountains, and vast oceans now separate the once powerful despot from his former seat of power -- his dark dreams of vengeance overwhelmed by the daily struggle for survival. But there is a larger drama that will entangle the broken dictator. An evil devastating and deadly seeks entrance to the land -- the mystical tool of a dark empire hungry for conquest and destruction -- and Kaspar has inadvertently discovered the key. Suddenly, Midkemia's last hope is a disgraced and exiled duke whose history is written in blood, and who now must wield his sword as her champion . . . if he so chooses..

De repente, la última esperanza de Midkemia es un duque deshonrado y exiliado cuya historia está escrita con sangre, y que ahora debe empuñar su espada como su campeón... si así lo decide.

title: Lamb
description: The birth of Jesus has been well chronicled, as have his glorious teachings, acts, and divine sacrifice after his thirtieth birthday. But no one knows about the early life of the Son of God, the missing years -- except Biff, the Messiah's best bud, who has been resurrected to tell the story in the divinely hilarious yet heartfelt work "reminiscent of Vonnegut and Douglas Adams" (Philadelphia Inquirer). Verily, the story Biff has to tell is a miraculous one, filled with remarkable journeys, magic, healings, kung fu, corpse reanimations, demons, and hot babes. Even the considerable wiles and devotion of the Savior's pal may not be enough to divert Joshua from his tragic destiny. But there's no one who loves Josh more -- except maybe "Maggie," Mary of Magdala -- and Biff isn't about to let his extraordinary pal suffer and ascend without a fight.

Pero nadie conoce los primeros años de vida del Hijo de Dios, los años que faltan, excepto Biff, el mejor amigo del Mesías, quien ha resucitado para contar la historia en esta obra divinamente hilarante y a la vez emotiva, que recuerda a Vonnegut y Douglas Adams (Philadelphia Inquirer). En verdad, la historia que Biff tiene que contar es milagrosa, llena de viajes extraordinarios, magia, curaciones, kung fu, reanimaciones de cadáveres, demonios y mujeres atractivas. Ni siquiera las considerables artimañas y la devoción del amigo del Salvador podrían ser suficientes para apartar a Joshua de su trágico destino. Pero nadie ama más a Josh, excepto quizás a "Maggie", María de Magdala, y Biff no está dispuesto a permitir que su extraordinario amigo sufra y ascienda sin luchar.

title: The Body in the Lighthouse
description: Something was very wrong on Sanpere this summer . . . To escape the misery of a sweltering August in Aleford, Massachusetts, caterer and minister's wife Faith Fairchild and her family head for their cottage on Maine's peaceful Sanpere Island in Penobscot Bay. But things have changed since their last visit. An aggressive developer is moving forward on plans that will destroy the unique ambience of the island, infuriating residents. Tensions are running dangerously high, and soon murder rears its hideous head. Faith discovers a corpse while exploring the grounds of Sanpere's historic lighthouse. With fear running rampant and volatile emotions approaching the detonation point, the intrepid sleuth must track down a killer for the sake of a friend and the island she loves.

title: The Nightingale's Song
description: Maggie Quinn thinks she has room in her head for only the helpless orphans in her care -- until Gordon Kincaid walks into St. Columba's. A proud Southern gentleman damaged by the Civil War, he has come to Baltimore to find the daughter he never knew -- a beautiful child who is one of Maggie's favorites -- and bring her home to Virginia. And when he asks Maggie to accompany them, all she can say is "yes." Widowed and wounded inside, Gordon turns to the emerald-eyed Irish beauty to help him pick up the pieces. Though he senses her distrust he is drawn to Maggie's angelic voice, her sensuality and passion...and to a tenderness that compels him to share with her his soul. But the scars of war go deep. And it will take uncommon strength for two people who stood on opposite sides to find redemption and a new life in love.

Pero las cicatrices de la guerra son profundas. Y se necesitará una fuerza extraordinaria para que dos personas que se mantuvieron en bandos opuestos encuentren la redención y una nueva vida en el amor.

title: In the Beginning...was the Command Line
description: This is "the Word" -- one man's word, certainly -- about the art (and artifice) of the state of our computer-centric existence. And considering that the "one man" is Neal Stephenson, "the hacker Hemingway" (Newsweek) -- acclaimed novelist, pragmatist, seer, nerd-friendly philosopher, and nationally bestselling author of groundbreaking literary works (Snow Crash, Cryptonomicon, etc., etc.) -- the word is well worth hearing. Mostly well-reasoned examination and partial rant, Stephenson's In the Beginning... was the Command Line is a thoughtful, irreverent, hilarious treatise on the cyber-culture past and present; on operating system tyrannies and downloaded popular revolutions; on the Internet, Disney World, Big Bangs, not to mention the meaning of life itself.

title: Olympos
description: Beneath the gaze of the gods, the mighty armies of Greece and Troy met in fierce and glorious combat, scrupulously following the text set forth in Homer's timeless narrative. But that was before twenty-first-century scholar Thomas Hockenberry stirred the bloody brew, causing an enraged Achilles to join forces with his archenemy Hector and turn his murderous wrath on Zeus and the entire pantheon of divine manipulators; before the swift and terrible mechanical creatures that catered for centuries to the pitiful idle remnants of Earth's human race began massing in the millions, to exterminate rather than serve. And now all bets are off.

Pero eso fue antes de que el erudito del siglo XXI, Thomas Hockenberry, agitara el sangriento brebaje, provocando que un enfurecido Aquiles uniera fuerzas con su archienemigo Héctor y dirigiera su ira asesina contra Zeus y todo el panteón de manipuladores divinos; antes de que las veloces y terribles criaturas mecánicas que durante siglos atendieron a los miserables y ociosos restos de la raza humana terrestre comenzaran a acumularse por millones, para exterminar en lugar de servir. Y ahora, todo está perdido.

title: The Marriage Lesson
description: Lesson #1: Never Tempt a Lady Become a bride? Never! Lady Marianne Shelton has come to London to experience life, and marriage is not part of her plan. To finance her independent future, the pretty country miss pens a series of anonymous stories. Soon they are the talk of the ton-and only she knows that her wicked hero is based on none other than bold, brash Thomas Effington, the future Duke of Roxborough. Lesson #2: Never Deny a Marquess, Thomas has been thrust into le of Marianne's protector. When she threatens to experience life with the first willing rogue to come along, he decides the best recourse is to tutor her himself. And when he accidentally compromises her honor, he's willing to accept their only recourse: a wedding. Marianne claims she wants no part of marriage, but her intoxicating allure and disarming willingness make her irresistible. And now Thomas is determined to teach her a lesson: that true love will last forever.

Y cuando accidentalmente compromete su honor, está dispuesto a aceptar su única opción: una boda. Marianne afirma que no quiere saber nada del matrimonio, pero su embriagador atractivo y su encantadora disposición la hacen irresistible. Y ahora Thomas está decidido a enseñarle una lección: que el amor verdadero dura para siempre.

title: Black and Blue
description: The Pulitzer Prizewinning New York Times columnist presents her third novel, which traces the dissolution of a passionate marriage into a violent nightmare, forcing Fran Benedetto to start a new life, and a new identity. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780385333139 The Pulitzer Prizewinning New York Times columnist presents her third novel, which traces the dissolution of a passionate marriage into a violent nightmare, forcing Fran Benedetto to start a new life, and a new identity. Reprint.
spanish_description: La columnista del New York Times, ganadora del Premio Pulitzer, presenta su tercera novela, que narra la ruptura de un matrimonio apasionado que se transforma en una violenta pesadilla, obligando a Fran Benedetto a comenzar una nueva vida y una nueva identidad. Reimpresión.

title: King Rat
description: Featuring dramatic never-before-published material from the original manuscript and a new introduction, the timeless classic details the conflict between a powerful black marketeer and his fellow prisoners at a Japanese POW camp that leads to tragedy. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780385333764 Featuring dramatic never-before-published material from the original manuscript and a new introduction, the timeless classic details the conflict between a powerful black marketeer and his fellow prisoners at a Japanese POW camp that leads to tragedy. Reprint.
spanish_description: Con material dramático inédito del manuscrito original y una nueva introducción, este clásico atemporal detalla el conflicto entre un poderoso traficante de mercado negro y sus compañeros de prisión en un campo de prisioneros de guerra japonés, que desemboca en una tragedia. Reimpresión.

title: Player Piano
description: Kurt Vonnegut's first novel spins the chilling tale of engineer Paul Proteus, who must find a way to live in a world dominated by a supercomputer and run completely by machines. Paul's rebellion is vintage Vonnegut—wildly funny, deadly serious, and terrifyingly close to reality.
tagged_description: 9780385333788 Kurt Vonnegut's first novel spins the chilling tale of engineer Paul Proteus, who must find a way to live in a world dominated by a supercomputer and run completely by machines. Paul's rebellion is vintage Vonnegut—wildly funny, deadly serious, and terrifyingly close to reality.
spanish_description: La primera novela de Kurt Vonnegut narra la escalofriante historia del ingeniero Paul Proteus, quien debe encontrar la manera de vivir en un mundo dominado por una supercomputadora y dirigido completamente por máquinas. La rebelión de Paul es típicamente Vonnegut: divertidísima, mortalmente seria y aterradoramente cercana a la realidad.

title: Wampeters, Foma & Granfalloons (opinions)
description: Wampeters, Foma & Granfalloons (Opinions) is a rare opportunity to experience Kurt Vonnegut speaking in his own voice about his own life, his views of the world, his writing, and the writing of others. An indignant, outrageous, witty, deeply felt collection of reviews, essays, and speeches, this is a window not only into Vonnegut's mind but also into his heart.
tagged_description: 9780385333818 Wampeters, Foma & Granfalloons (Opinions) is a rare opportunity to experience Kurt Vonnegut speaking in his own voice about his own life, his views of the world, his writing, and the writing of others. An indignant, outrageous, witty, deeply felt collection of reviews, essays, and speeches, this is a window not only into Vonnegut's mind but also into his heart.
spanish_description: Wampeters, Foma & Granfalloons (Opiniones) es una oportunidad única para escuchar a Kurt Vonnegut hablar con su propia voz sobre su vida, su visión del mundo, su escritura y la de otros. Una colección de reseñas, ensayos y discursos indignada, escandalosa, ingeniosa y profundamente sentida, que es una ventana no solo a la mente de Vonnegut, sino también a su corazón.

title: Galapagos: A Novel
description: The ghost of a decapitated shipbuilder wryly observes the decline of the human race as reflected by a group of shipwreck survivors, including a biology teacher, a bomb-radiated wife of a Japanese computer genius, and a gold digger, a motley band whose fates are shaped by infertility and a local tribe of cannibals. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780385333870 The ghost of a decapitated shipbuilder wryly observes the decline of the human race as reflected by a group of shipwreck survivors, including a biology teacher, a bomb-radiated wife of a Japanese computer genius, and a gold digger, a motley band whose fates are shaped by infertility and a local tribe of cannibals. Reissue.
spanish_description: El fantasma de un constructor naval decapitado observa con ironía el declive de la raza humana, reflejado en un grupo de supervivientes de un naufragio, entre ellos un profesor de biología, la esposa de un genio informático japonés, afectada por una bomba, y un cazafortunas, una banda heterogénea cuyo destino está determinado por la infertilidad y una tribu local de caníbales. Reedición.

title: Jailbird
description: A master of contemporary American literature, Vonnegut has authored 18 highly acclaimed books and dozens of short stories and essays. This wry tale follows bumbling bureaucrat Walter F. Starbuck from Harvard to the Nixon White House to the penitentiary as Watergate's least known co-conspirator.
tagged_description: 9780385333900 A master of contemporary American literature, Vonnegut has authored 18 highly acclaimed books and dozens of short stories and essays. This wry tale follows bumbling bureaucrat Walter F. Starbuck from Harvard to the Nixon White House to the penitentiary as Watergate's least known co-conspirator.
spanish_description: Maestro de la literatura estadounidense contemporánea, Vonnegut ha escrito 18 libros aclamados y docenas de cuentos y ensayos. Esta irónica historia sigue al torpe burócrata Walter F. Starbuck desde Harvard hasta la Casa Blanca de Nixon y la penitenciaría, como el cómplice menos conocido del Watergate.

title: Slapstick
description: Flying to a favorite uncle's funeral, a middle-aged Kurt Vonnegut daydreams of one-hundred-year-old Wilbur Oriole-11 Swain, pediatrician and past United States President, who wrote history's most popular child-rearing manual and sold the original Louisian
tagged_description: 9780385334235 Flying to a favorite uncle's funeral, a middle-aged Kurt Vonnegut daydreams of one-hundred-year-old Wilbur Oriole-11 Swain, pediatrician and past United States President, who wrote history's most popular child-rearing manual and sold the original Louisian
spanish_description: Mientras vuela hacia el funeral de su tío favorito, Kurt Vonnegut, de mediana edad, sueña despierto con Wilbur Oriole-11 Swain, un pediatra y expresidente de los Estados Unidos de cien años que escribió el manual de crianza infantil más popular de la historia y vendió el libro original de Luisiana.

title: Palm Sunday
description: An autobiographical collage from the renowned novelist includes previously unpublished articles, essays, letters, drawings, songs, and talks in which Vonnegut reflects on his life and times
tagged_description: 9780385334266 An autobiographical collage from the renowned novelist includes previously unpublished articles, essays, letters, drawings, songs, and talks in which Vonnegut reflects on his life and times
spanish_description: Un collage autobiográfico del reconocido novelista incluye artículos, ensayos, cartas, dibujos, canciones y charlas inéditos en los que Vonnegut reflexiona sobre su vida y su época.

title: The Midwife's Tale
description: Serving as midwives to a small mining town in prewar Appalachia, Elizabeth and her mother share in the intimate details of the lives, loves, and losses of every family in the region, but none of their neighbors know their own secrets, dreams, and desires--including the mystery of Elizabeth's father's identity or of Elizabeth's desperate yearning for her own child. A first novel. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780385335546 Serving as midwives to a small mining town in prewar Appalachia, Elizabeth and her mother share in the intimate details of the lives, loves, and losses of every family in the region, but none of their neighbors know their own secrets, dreams, and desires--including the mystery of Elizabeth's father's identity or of Elizabeth's desperate yearning for her own child. A first novel. Reprint.
spanish_description: Como parteras en un pequeño pueblo minero de los Apalaches antes de la guerra, Elizabeth y su madre comparten los detalles íntimos de las vidas, amores y pérdidas de cada familia de la región, pero ninguno de sus vecinos conoce sus propios secretos, sueños y deseos, incluyendo el misterio de la identidad del padre de Elizabeth o su desesperado anhelo por tener un hijo. Primera novela. Reimpresión.

title: Kissing in Manhattan
description: At the Preemption, a mysterious apartment building with a prophetic doorman named Sender, the destinies of an offbeat group of tenants intertwine with the lives of three characters--James Branch, a shy accountant attached to the building's antique elevator; Wall Street lothario Patrick Rigg; and Rally McWilliams, an aspiring writer searching for a soulmate, in a collection of interlinked stories. Reissue. 45,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385335676 At the Preemption, a mysterious apartment building with a prophetic doorman named Sender, the destinies of an offbeat group of tenants intertwine with the lives of three characters--James Branch, a shy accountant attached to the building's antique elevator; Wall Street lothario Patrick Rigg; and Rally McWilliams, an aspiring writer searching for a soulmate, in a collection of interlinked stories. Reissue. 45,000 first printing.
spanish_description: En el Preemption, un misterioso edificio de apartamentos con un portero profético llamado Sender, los destinos de un peculiar grupo de inquilinos se entrelazan con las vidas de tres personajes: James Branch, un tímido contable adicto al antiguo ascensor del edificio; Patrick Rigg, un donjuán de Wall Street; y Rally McWilliams, un aspirante a escritor en busca de su alma gemela, en una colección de historias interconectadas. Reedición. Primera tirada de 45.000 ejemplares.

title: Dragonfly in Amber
description: In eighteenth-century Scotland, Claire Randall and her raven-haired daughter, Brianna, return to the majestic hills where Claire recalls the love of her life--gallant warrior James Fraser.
tagged_description: 9780385335973 In eighteenth-century Scotland, Claire Randall and her raven-haired daughter, Brianna, return to the majestic hills where Claire recalls the love of her life--gallant warrior James Fraser.
spanish_description: En la Escocia del siglo XVIII, Claire Randall y su hija de cabello negro, Brianna, regresan a las majestuosas colinas donde Claire recuerda al amor de su vida: el valiente guerrero James Fraser.

title: Voyager
description: Time-travelling Claire Randall returns to her own time, pregnant and weary, and resumes her life, but her memories of her eighteenth-century Scottish lover Jamie Fraser will not die, leading her to a desperate decision to return to him.
tagged_description: 9780385335997 Time-travelling Claire Randall returns to her own time, pregnant and weary, and resumes her life, but her memories of her eighteenth-century Scottish lover Jamie Fraser will not die, leading her to a desperate decision to return to him.
spanish_description: Claire Randall, una viajera en el tiempo, regresa a su época, embarazada y cansada, y reanuda su vida, pero sus recuerdos de su amante escocés del siglo XVIII, Jamie Fraser, no mueren, lo que la lleva a tomar una decisión desesperada: regresar con él.

title: Intuition
description: A trio of researchers becomes caught up in the desperate quest for a financial grant from the Philpott, a prestigious research laboratory in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
tagged_description: 9780385336109 A trio of researchers becomes caught up in the desperate quest for a financial grant from the Philpott, a prestigious research laboratory in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
spanish_description: Un trío de investigadores se ve envuelto en la búsqueda desesperada de una subvención financiera del Philpott, un prestigioso laboratorio de investigación en Cambridge, Massachusetts.

title: The Cloud Atlas
description: During World War II, Louis Belk, a young American bomb disposal sergeant, is sent on a mission to Anchorage, Alaska, to find and disarm the balloon bombs launched by the Japanese against North America, a search that leads him to encounters with a variety of haunting individuals and sends him on a lifelong quest to understand the meaning of faith, friendship, trust, and love. A first novel. Reprint. 25,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385336956 During World War II, Louis Belk, a young American bomb disposal sergeant, is sent on a mission to Anchorage, Alaska, to find and disarm the balloon bombs launched by the Japanese against North America, a search that leads him to encounters with a variety of haunting individuals and sends him on a lifelong quest to understand the meaning of faith, friendship, trust, and love. A first novel. Reprint. 25,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Durante la Segunda Guerra Mundial, Louis Belk, un joven sargento estadounidense de desactivación de bombas, es enviado en misión a Anchorage, Alaska, para encontrar y desactivar los globos bomba lanzados por los japoneses contra Norteamérica. Esta búsqueda lo lleva a encontrarse con diversos personajes inquietantes y lo embarca en una búsqueda que durará toda la vida para comprender el significado de la fe, la amistad, la confianza y el amor. Primera novela. Reimpresión. 25.000 ejemplares de la primera tirada.

title: Lucifer's Shadow
description: Disillusioned by the darker side of Venice, English cataloguer Daniel Forster discovers a lost musical masterpiece within a library of dusty manuscripts and is drawn into a treacherous game of deception that spans three centuries, from the periods of Vivaldi and Rousseau to the present. Reprint. 20,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385338059 Disillusioned by the darker side of Venice, English cataloguer Daniel Forster discovers a lost musical masterpiece within a library of dusty manuscripts and is drawn into a treacherous game of deception that spans three centuries, from the periods of Vivaldi and Rousseau to the present. Reprint. 20,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Desilusionado por el lado oscuro de Venecia, el catalogador inglés Daniel Forster descubre una obra maestra musical perdida en una biblioteca de manuscritos polvorientos y se ve envuelto en un peligroso juego de engaños que abarca tres siglos, desde los periodos de Vivaldi y Rousseau hasta la actualidad. Reimpresión. Primera tirada de 20.000 ejemplares.

title: The Client
description: Eleven-year-old Mark Sway accidentally witnesses a murder and becomes the target of relentless prosecutors and the mob, and the only person who can save him is Reggie Love, an attorney barely out of law school. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385339087 Eleven-year-old Mark Sway accidentally witnesses a murder and becomes the target of relentless prosecutors and the mob, and the only person who can save him is Reggie Love, an attorney barely out of law school. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Mark Sway, de once años, presencia accidentalmente un asesinato y se convierte en el blanco de implacables fiscales y la mafia. La única persona que puede salvarlo es Reggie Love, una abogada recién salida de la facultad de derecho. Reimpresión. 35.000 ejemplares (primera edición).

title: The Street Lawyer
description: After a violent encounter with a homeless man, talented corporate lawyer Michael finds himself out in the streets, lucky to be alive, and holding a top-secret file belonging to his former employers, a top law firm hiding a terrible secret. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385339094 After a violent encounter with a homeless man, talented corporate lawyer Michael finds himself out in the streets, lucky to be alive, and holding a top-secret file belonging to his former employers, a top law firm hiding a terrible secret. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Tras un violento encuentro con un indigente, el talentoso abogado corporativo Michael se encuentra en la calle, con suerte de estar vivo, y con un expediente ultrasecreto perteneciente a sus antiguos empleadores, un importante bufete de abogados que oculta un terrible secreto. Reimpresión. 35.000 ejemplares (primera impresión).

title: The Summons
description: Ray Atlee and his brother, Forrest, receive a letter from their father, a reclusive, retired judge, instructing them to return home to Clanton, Mississippi, to discuss his estate, but the judge dies before his sons arrive, leaving behind a secret known only to Ray. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385339599 Ray Atlee and his brother, Forrest, receive a letter from their father, a reclusive, retired judge, instructing them to return home to Clanton, Mississippi, to discuss his estate, but the judge dies before his sons arrive, leaving behind a secret known only to Ray. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Ray Atlee y su hermano, Forrest, reciben una carta de su padre, un juez retirado y solitario, instándolos a regresar a su hogar en Clanton, Misisipi, para hablar sobre su patrimonio. Sin embargo, el juez fallece antes de que lleguen sus hijos, dejando tras sí un secreto que solo Ray conoce. Reimpresión. Primera tirada: 35.000 ejemplares.

title: The Rainmaker
description: Abandoning his aspirations about living the good life, novice Memphis lawyer Rudy Baylor fears he will lose everything in the face of a pivotal case that could cost him his life or turn him into the biggest rainmaker in the land as he stumbles upon a huge case of insurance fraud in which he must go head to head with one of the most powerful defense attorneys and industries in America. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385339605 Abandoning his aspirations about living the good life, novice Memphis lawyer Rudy Baylor fears he will lose everything in the face of a pivotal case that could cost him his life or turn him into the biggest rainmaker in the land as he stumbles upon a huge case of insurance fraud in which he must go head to head with one of the most powerful defense attorneys and industries in America. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Abandonando sus aspiraciones de una buena vida, el abogado novato de Memphis, Rudy Baylor, teme perderlo todo ante un caso crucial que podría costarle la vida o convertirlo en el mayor magnate del país, al encontrarse con un caso de fraude de seguros de gran envergadura en el que deberá enfrentarse a uno de los abogados defensores y a una de las industrias más poderosas de Estados Unidos. Reimpresión. 35.000 ejemplares (primera impresión).

title: The King of Torts
description: Washed-up public defender Clay Carter's latest case, a routine street killing, takes an unexpected turn when he discovers evidence of a conspiracy involving a large drug company and a lawsuit with a huge potential settlement. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385339650 Washed-up public defender Clay Carter's latest case, a routine street killing, takes an unexpected turn when he discovers evidence of a conspiracy involving a large drug company and a lawsuit with a huge potential settlement. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
spanish_description: El último caso del fracasado defensor público Clay Carter, un asesinato callejero rutinario, da un giro inesperado al descubrir pruebas de una conspiración que involucra a una gran empresa farmacéutica y una demanda con un posible acuerdo millonario. Reimpresión. 35.000 ejemplares (primera impresión).

title: The Chamber
description: Years after the bombing of a Mississippi law office in which Marvin Kramer's two sons died, former Klan member Sam Cayhill, the accused killer, has nearly exhausted his death row appeals, until young lawyer Adam Hall takes the case. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385339667 Years after the bombing of a Mississippi law office in which Marvin Kramer's two sons died, former Klan member Sam Cayhill, the accused killer, has nearly exhausted his death row appeals, until young lawyer Adam Hall takes the case. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Años después del atentado con bomba en un bufete de abogados de Mississippi donde murieron los dos hijos de Marvin Kramer, el exmiembro del Ku Klux Klan, Sam Cayhill, acusado de asesinato, casi ha agotado sus apelaciones en el corredor de la muerte, hasta que el joven abogado Adam Hall toma el caso. Reimpresión. 35.000 ejemplares (primera impresión).

title: The Brethren
description: In a maximum security federal prison, three former judges who call themselves "the brethren" meet daily in the law library to run a rougher form of justice inside their new community, and make a little money, but when one of their scams derails, they are forced to confront the world of their own creation. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385339674 In a maximum security federal prison, three former judges who call themselves "the brethren" meet daily in the law library to run a rougher form of justice inside their new community, and make a little money, but when one of their scams derails, they are forced to confront the world of their own creation. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
spanish_description: En una prisión federal de máxima seguridad, tres exjueces que se hacen llamar "los hermanos" se reúnen a diario en la biblioteca de derecho para impartir justicia más severa en su nueva comunidad y ganar algo de dinero. Sin embargo, cuando una de sus estafas fracasa, se ven obligados a enfrentarse al mundo que ellos mismos han creado. Reimpresión. 35.000 ejemplares (primera edición).

title: The Runaway Jury
description: A member of the jury for the century's most explosive trial against a giant tobacco company, Juror #2, a mysterious man with a past and a hidden agenda, joins forces with a beautiful woman on the outside to get the verdict he wants, no matter what the cost. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385339698 A member of the jury for the century's most explosive trial against a giant tobacco company, Juror #2, a mysterious man with a past and a hidden agenda, joins forces with a beautiful woman on the outside to get the verdict he wants, no matter what the cost. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Miembro del jurado del juicio más explosivo del siglo contra una gigantesca tabacalera, el Jurado n.º 2, un hombre misterioso con un pasado y una agenda oculta, une fuerzas con una hermosa mujer ajena al juicio para obtener el veredicto que desea, cueste lo que cueste. Reimpresión. Primera tirada de 35 000 ejemplares.

title: The Pelican Brief
description: When the Supreme Court's most liberal and most conservative justices are gunned down, law student Darby Shaw builds a case against a powerful suspect, whose threats send her underground. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780385339704 When the Supreme Court's most liberal and most conservative justices are gunned down, law student Darby Shaw builds a case against a powerful suspect, whose threats send her underground. Reprint. 35,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Cuando los jueces más liberales y conservadores de la Corte Suprema son asesinados a tiros, la estudiante de derecho Darby Shaw construye un caso contra un poderoso sospechoso, cuyas amenazas la llevan a la clandestinidad. Reimpresión. 35.000 ejemplares. Primera impresión.

title: A Breath of Snow and Ashes
description: In 1772, Jamie Fraser is asked by the governor to help protect the colonies for King and Crown, but thanks to his time-traveling, twentieth-century wife, Claire, Jamie is aware of the ultimate result of the American Revolution.
title_and_subtitle: A Breath of Snow and Ashes
tagged_description: 9780385340397 In 1772, Jamie Fraser is asked by the governor to help protect the colonies for King and Crown, but thanks to his time-traveling, twentieth-century wife, Claire, Jamie is aware of the ultimate result of the American Revolution.
spanish_description: En 1772, el gobernador le pide a Jamie Fraser que ayude a proteger las colonias para el Rey y la Corona, pero gracias a su esposa Claire, del siglo XX y viajera en el tiempo, Jamie es consciente del resultado final de la Revolución estadounidense.

title: The Golden Tulip
description: Determined to become a painter, Francesca Visser's dream is shattered when her father--a struggling artist--arranges a marriage between her and Ludolf Van Deventer, a wealthy shipbroker, in order to pay back a debt
tagged_description: 9780385415606 Determined to become a painter, Francesca Visser's dream is shattered when her father--a struggling artist--arranges a marriage between her and Ludolf Van Deventer, a wealthy shipbroker, in order to pay back a debt
spanish_description: Decidida a convertirse en pintora, el sueño de Francesca Visser se hace añicos cuando su padre, un artista con dificultades, organiza un matrimonio entre ella y Ludolf Van Deventer, un rico corredor de barcos, para pagar una deuda.

title: How the Irish Saved Civilization
description: Bringing readers to the Ireland of St. Patrick and the Book of Kells, a historical examination of Ireland's role in the rise of medieval Europe cites the work of countless monks and scribes in the preservation of the West's written treasury. Reprint. Tour.
title_and_subtitle: How the Irish Saved Civilization: The Untold Story of Ireland's Heroic Role from the Fall of Rome to the Rise of Medieval Europe
tagged_description: 9780385418492 Bringing readers to the Ireland of St. Patrick and the Book of Kells, a historical examination of Ireland's role in the rise of medieval Europe cites the work of countless monks and scribes in the preservation of the West's written treasury. Reprint. Tour.
spanish_description: Llevando al lector a la Irlanda de San Patricio y el Libro de Kells, un análisis histórico del papel de Irlanda en el auge de la Europa medieval cita la labor de innumerables monjes y escribas en la preservación del tesoro escrito de Occidente. Reimpresión. Gira.

title: The Power of Myth
description: The noted mythologist discusses the relationship of ancient myths to modern life, including discussions of recent heros, tales of love and marriage, the power of myth, and mythic themes
tagged_description: 9780385418867 The noted mythologist discusses the relationship of ancient myths to modern life, including discussions of recent heros, tales of love and marriage, the power of myth, and mythic themes
spanish_description: El destacado mitólogo analiza la relación de los mitos antiguos con la vida moderna, incluyendo debates sobre héroes recientes, cuentos de amor y matrimonio, el poder del mito y temas míticos.

title: On the Origins of War and the Preservation of Peace
description: Analyzes history to determine why there are wars, whether there are underlying laws that explain why one nation challenges another, and whether there are forces working for the preservation of peace
title_and_subtitle: On the Origins of War and the Preservation of Peace
tagged_description: 9780385423755 Analyzes history to determine why there are wars, whether there are underlying laws that explain why one nation challenges another, and whether there are forces working for the preservation of peace
spanish_description: Analiza la historia para determinar por qué hay guerras, si existen leyes subyacentes que expliquen por qué una nación desafía a otra y si hay fuerzas que trabajan para la preservación de la paz.

title: Texas! Trilogy
description: The romantic adventures of Lucky, Chase, and Sage are presented in one volume relating the entire epic saga of the Tyler Drilling company and the three strong-willed Tyler siblings
title_and_subtitle: Texas! Trilogy: Texas! Lucky; Texas! Chase; Texas! Sage
tagged_description: 9780385424707 The romantic adventures of Lucky, Chase, and Sage are presented in one volume relating the entire epic saga of the Tyler Drilling company and the three strong-willed Tyler siblings
spanish_description: Las aventuras románticas de Lucky, Chase y Sage se presentan en un solo volumen que relata toda la saga épica de la empresa Tyler Drilling y los tres hermanos Tyler de voluntad fuerte.

title: Obasan
description: A moving vision of an affront to democratic principles... A tour de force, a deeply felt novel, brilliantly poetic in its sensibility' - New York Times
tagged_description: 9780385468862 'A moving vision of an affront to democratic principles... A tour de force, a deeply felt novel, brilliantly poetic in its sensibility' - New York Times
spanish_description: Una visión conmovedora de un agravio a los principios democráticos... Un tour de force, una novela profundamente sentida, brillantemente poética en su sensibilidad' - New York Times

title: Like Water for Chocolate
description: Despite the fact that she has fallen in love with a young man, Tita, the youngest of three daughters born to a tyrannical rancher, must obey tradition and remain single and at home to care for her mother. Reprint. Movie tie-in.
title_and_subtitle: Like Water for Chocolate: A Novel in Monthly Installments, with Recipes, Romances, and Home Remedies
tagged_description: 9780385474016 Despite the fact that she has fallen in love with a young man, Tita, the youngest of three daughters born to a tyrannical rancher, must obey tradition and remain single and at home to care for her mother. Reprint. Movie tie-in.
spanish_description: A pesar de haberse enamorado de un joven, Tita, la menor de tres hijas de un ranchero tiránico, debe obedecer la tradición y permanecer soltera y en casa para cuidar de su madre. Reimpresión. Conexión con la película.

title: Youth in Revolt
description: Nick Twisp, a dark and precocious fourteen-year-old, struggles with the problems of contemporary teens, including high school, divorced parents, paranoia, his virginity, homelessness, and the attentions of a young lady
title_and_subtitle: Youth in Revolt: The Journals of Nick Twisp
tagged_description: 9780385481960 Nick Twisp, a dark and precocious fourteen-year-old, struggles with the problems of contemporary teens, including high school, divorced parents, paranoia, his virginity, homelessness, and the attentions of a young lady
spanish_description: Nick Twisp, un adolescente oscuro y precoz de catorce años, lucha con los problemas de los adolescentes contemporáneos, incluidos la escuela secundaria, sus padres divorciados, la paranoia, su virginidad, la falta de vivienda y las atenciones de una joven.

title: Marie Antoinette
description: The acclaimed author of The Six Wives of Henry VIII describes her life, from her betrothal as an unsophisticated, poorly educated fourteen-year-old girl to the future King Louis XVI, through her difficult marriage in the French court, to her courage in the face of revolutionaries who sent her to the guillotine twenty-three years later. Reader's Guide available. Reprint. 75,000 first printing.

title: The Da Vinci Code
description: MORE THAN 80 MILLION COPIES SOLD Nominated as one of America’s best-loved novels by PBS’s The Great American Read While in Paris, Harvard symbologist Robert Langdon is awakened by a phone call in the dead of the night. The elderly curator of the Louvre has been murdered inside the museum, his body covered in baffling symbols. As Langdon and gifted French cryptologist Sophie Neveu sort through the bizarre riddles, they are stunned to discover a trail of clues hidden in the works of Leonardo da Vinci—clues visible for all to see and yet ingeniously disguised by the painter. Even more startling, the late curator was involved in the Priory of Sion—a secret society whose members included Sir Isaac Newton, Victor Hugo, and Da Vinci—and he guarded a breathtaking historical secret. Unless Langdon and Neveu can decipher the labyrinthine puzzle—while avoiding the faceless adversary who shadows their every move—the explosive, ancient truth will be lost forever.

El anciano conservador del Louvre ha sido asesinado dentro del museo, su cuerpo cubierto de símbolos desconcertantes. Mientras Langdon y la talentosa criptóloga francesa Sophie Neveu ordenan los extraños acertijos, se quedan atónitos al descubrir un rastro de pistas ocultas en las obras de Leonardo da Vinci, pistas visibles para todos y, sin embargo, ingeniosamente disfrazadas por el pintor. Aún más sorprendente, el difunto conservador estaba involucrado en el Priorato de Sión, una sociedad secreta cuyos miembros incluían a Sir Isaac Newton, Victor Hugo y Da Vinci, y guardaba un secreto histórico impresionante. A menos que Langdon y Neveu puedan descifrar el laberíntico rompecabezas, mientras evitan al adversario sin rostro que sigue cada uno de sus movimientos, la explosiva y antigua verdad se perderá para siempre.

title: House of Leaves
description: Johnny Truant wild and troubled sometime employee in a LA tattoo parlour, finds a notebook kept by Zampano, a reclusive old man found dead in a cluttered apartment. Herein is the heavily annotated story of the Navidson Report. Will Navidson, a photojournalist, and his family move into a new house. What happens next is recorded on videotapes and in interviews. Now the Navidsons are household names. Zampano, writing on loose sheets, stained napkins, crammed notebooks, has compiled what must be the definitive work on the events on Ash Tree Lane. But Johnny Truant has never heard of the Navidson Record. Nor has anyone else he knows. And the more he reads about Will Navidson's house, the more frightened he becomes. Paranoia besets him. The worst part is that he can't just dismiss the notebook as the ramblings of a crazy old man. He's starting to notice things changing around him . . . Immensely imaginative. Impossible to put down. Impossible to forget. House of Leavesis thrilling, terrifying and unlike anything you have ever read before.

Aquí está la historia, profusamente anotada, del Informe Navidson. Will Navidson, fotoperiodista, y su familia se mudan a una nueva casa. Lo que sucede después queda grabado en cintas de vídeo y en entrevistas. Ahora los Navidson son nombres familiares. Zampano, escribiendo en hojas sueltas, servilletas manchadas y cuadernos abarrotados, ha compilado lo que debe ser la obra definitiva sobre los sucesos de Ash Tree Lane. Pero Johnny Truant nunca ha oído hablar del Registro Navidson. Ni nadie más que conozca. Y cuanto más lee sobre la casa de Will Navidson, más miedo siente. La paranoia lo acosa. Lo peor es que no puede descartar el cuaderno como las divagaciones de un viejo loco. Empieza a notar que las cosas cambian a su alrededor... Inmensamente imaginativo. Imposible de soltar. Imposible de olvidar. La Casa de Hojas es emocionante, aterradora y diferente a todo lo que hayas leído antes.

title: The French Kitchen
description: Joanne Harris's bestselling novels, Chocolat, Blackberry Wine and Five-Quarters of the Orange, are affectionately known as her culinary trilogy. In them, Joanne Harris whets our appetites with some tantalisingly delicious recipes taken from her own grandmere's recipe book. For, like Framboise, the heroine of Five-Quarters of the Orange, Joanne has family recipes which have been passed down through the generations and which she shares with us now in a mouth-watering celebration of French cuisine. From pumkin soup to Moules Mariniere, from Tarte aux cassis to Fouace Aveyronnaise (Grandmother's festival loaf), and taking in salads, starters, fish, poultry and plenty more along the way, these are simple and stylish recipes from the heart of the French family kitchen. Illustrated with stunning integrated photographs and complemented by anecdotes from her family, past and present, The French Kitchen will be a must-have cookbook for all lovers of food and France.

Ilustrado con impresionantes fotografías integradas y complementado con anécdotas de su familia, pasadas y presentes, La Cocina Francesa será un libro de cocina imprescindible para todos los amantes de la gastronomía y de Francia.

title: The Age of Grief
description: The luminous novella and stories in The Age of Grief explore the vicissitudes of love, friendship, and marriage with all the compassion and insight that have come to be expected from Jane Smiley, the Pulitzer Prize—winning author of A Thousand Acres. In “The Pleasure of Her Company,” a lonely, single woman befriends the married couple next door, hoping to learn the secret of their happiness. In “Long Distance,” a man finds himself relieved of the obligation to continue an affair that is no longer compelling to him, only to be waylaid by the guilt he feels at his easy escape. And in the incandescently wise and moving title novella, a dentist, aware that his wife has fallen in love with someone else, must comfort her when she is spurned, while maintaining the secret of his own complicated sorrow. Beautifully written, with a wry intelligence and a lively comic touch, The Age of Grief captures moments of great intimacy with grace, clarity, and indelible emotional power.

En "The Pleasure of Her Company", una mujer soltera y solitaria se hace amiga del matrimonio de al lado, con la esperanza de descubrir el secreto de su felicidad. En "Long Distance", un hombre se ve liberado de la obligación de continuar una aventura que ya no le resulta atractiva, solo para verse abrumado por la culpa que siente por su fácil escape. Y en la novela corta que da título al libro, incandescentemente sabia y conmovedora, un dentista, consciente de que su esposa se ha enamorado de otro, debe consolarla cuando es rechazada, mientras guarda el secreto de su propio y complejo dolor. Bellamente escrita, con una inteligencia irónica y un vibrante toque cómico, The Age of Grief captura momentos de gran intimidad con gracia, claridad y una fuerza emocional indeleble.

title: Maurice
description: Set in the elegant Edwardian world of Cambridge undergraduate life, this story by a master novelist introduces us to Maurice Hall when he is fourteen. We follow him through public school and Cambridge, and into his father's firm. In a highly structured society, Maurice is a conventional young man in almost every way--except that his is homosexual.Written during 1913 and 1914, immediately after Howards End, and not published until 1971, Maurice was ahead of its time in its theme and in its affirmation that love between men can be happy. "Happiness," Forster wrote, "is its keynote.... In Maurice I tried to create a character who was completely unlike myself or what I supposed myself to be: someone handsome, healthy, bodily attractive, mentally torpid, not a bad businessman and rather a snob. Into this mixture I dropped an ingredient that puzzles him, wakes him up, torments him and finally saves him."

title: The Awakening
description: The text is that of the first edition of the novel, published by Herbert S. Stone in 1899. It has been annotated by the editor and includes translations of French phrases and information about New Orleans locales, customs, and lore, the Bayou region, and Creole culture. "Bibliographical and Historical Contexts", expanded and introduced by a new Editor's Note, presents biographical, historical, and cultural documents contemporary with the novel's publication. Included are a biographical essay by the acclaimed Chopin biographer Emily Toth, "An Etiquette/Advice Book Sampler" with selections from the conduct books of the period in which Chopin lived and wrote, and period fashion plates from Harper's Bazar. A comprehensive "Criticism" section, introduced by a new Editor's Note, contains expanded selections from hard-to-find contemporary reviews of the novel; two letters of mysterious origin written in response to the novel; and Chopin's "Retraction," which followed The Awakening's negative reception. These are followed by twenty-seven interpretive essays, twelve of them new to the Second Edition, that provide a variety of perspectives on The Awakening, including essays by Cynthia Griffin Wolff, Nancy Walker, Elizabeth Fox-Genovese, Paula A. Treichler, Sandra M. Gilbert, Lee R. Edwards, Patricia S. Yaeger, Elizabeth Ammons, and Elaine Showalter. A Chronology of Chopin's life and an updated Selected Bibliography are also included.
