title: The history of sexuality
description: In this sequel to The History of Sexuality, Volume I: An Introduction, the brilliantly original French thinker who died in 1984 gives an analysis of how the ancient Greeks perceived sexuality. Throughout The Uses of Pleasure Foucault analyzes an irresistible array of ancient Greek texts on eroticism as he tries to answer basic questions: How in the West did sexual experience become a moral issue? And why were other appetites of the body, such as hunger, and collective concerns, such as civic duty, not subjected to the numberless rules and regulations and judgments that have defined, if not confined, sexual behavior?

title: Revenge of the Lawn
description: Three unforgettable Brautigan masterpieces reissued in a one-volume omnibus edition. REVENGE OF THE LAWN: Originally published in 1971, these bizarre flashes of insight and humor cover everything from "A High Building in Singapore" to the "Perfect California Day." This is Brautigan's only collection of stories and includes "The Lost Chapters of TROUT FISHING IN AMERICA." THE ABORTION: AN HISTORICAL ROMANCE 1966: A public library in California where none of the books have ever been published is full of romantic possibilities. But when the librarian and his girlfriend must travel to Tijuana, they have a series of strange encounters in Brautigan's 1971 novel. SO THE WIND WON'T BLOW IT ALL AWAY: It is 1979, and a man is recalling the events of his twelfth summer, when he bought bullets for his gun instead of a hamburger. Written just before his death, and published in 1982, this novel foreshadowed Brautigan's suicide.

title: A Clockwork Orange
description: Anthony Burgess's stage play of his infamous cult novel and film of the same name. Alex and his vicious teenage gang revel in horrific violence, mugging and gang rape. Alex also revels in the music of Beethoven. The Gang communicates in a language which is as complicated as their actions. When a drug-fuelled night of fun ends in murder, Alex is finally busted and banged up. He is given a choice - be brainwashed into good citizenship and set free, or face a lifetime inside. A Clockwork Orangewas made into a film classic by Stanley Kubrick in 1971 and was dramatizes by the RSC in 1990.

But when they start building the bird city for real, Pez starts to have ambitions - which seem not a million miles away from dictatorship. title: The Franco-Prussian War

title: Diana Wynne Jones
description: This study follows the aesthetic of the sublime from Burke and Kant, through Wordsworth and the Shelleys, into Thackeray, Dickens, Eliot and Hardy. Exploring the continuities between the romantic and Victorian "periods" that have so often been rather read as differences, the book demonstrate that the sublime mode enables the transition from a paradigm of overwhelming power exemplified by the body of the king to the pervasive power of surveillance utilized by the rising middle classes. While the domestic woman connected with the rise of the middle class is normally seen as beautiful, the book contends that the moral authority given to this icon of depth and interiority is actually sublime. The binary of the beautiful and the sublime seeks to contain the sublimity of womanhood by insisting on sublimity's masculine character. This is the book's most important claim: rather than exemplifying masculine strength, the sublime marks the transition to a system of power gendered as feminine and yet masks that transition because it fears the power it ostensibly accords to the feminine. This aesthetic is both an inheritance the Victorians receive from their romantic predecessors, and, more importantly, a broad historical phenomenon that questions the artificial boundaries between romantic and Victorian.

spanish_description: Este estudio analiza la estética de lo sublime desde Burke y Kant, pasando por Wordsworth y los Shelley, hasta llegar a Thackeray, Dickens, Eliot y Hardy. Al explorar las continuidades entre los períodos romántico y victoriano, que a menudo se han interpretado como diferencias, el libro demuestra que el modo sublime facilita la transición de un paradigma de poder abrumador, ejemplificado por el cuerpo del rey, al poder omnipresente de vigilancia utilizado por las clases medias en ascenso. Si bien la mujer doméstica, vinculada al auge de la clase media, suele considerarse bella, el libro sostiene que la autoridad moral otorgada a este ícono de profundidad e interioridad es, en realidad, sublime. La dicotomía entre lo bello y lo sublime busca contener la sublimidad de la feminidad insistiendo en su carácter masculino. Esta es la afirmación más importante del libro: en lugar de ejemplificar la fuerza masculina, lo sublime marca la transición a un sistema de poder definido como femenino, pero enmascara dicha transición por temor al poder que aparentemente otorga a lo femenino. Esta estética es a la vez una herencia que los victorianos reciben de sus predecesores románticos y, aún más importante, un amplio fenómeno histórico que cuestiona las fronteras artificiales entre lo romántico y lo victoriano.

title: Debt of Honor
description: Every novel by Tom Clancy has been "a jaw-tightener and a nail-biter of the first order, " as the San Diego Union described Without Remorse. But Debt of Honor surpasses them all, with Jack Ryan facing his greatest challenge - against a peril that may become all too real. In retrospect, it would seem an odd way to start a war. . . . The end of history. The new world order. Fine phrases, but as Jack Ryan is about to discover, history isn't dead yet - and only the nature of the threat is new. On the Pacific island of Saipan, a wealthy Japanese businessman regards his new-bought land with satisfaction. In the Indian Ocean off Sri Lanka, a foreign navy begins a series of highly unusual exercises. At the headquarters of America's major stock-clearing corporation, an engineer brings a customized computer program on-line for the first time, and smiles at his own private joke. Three seemingly unrelated incidents, but all just the first links in a chain of events that will stun the world. Called out of retirement to serve as the new President's National Security Advisor, Jack Ryan quickly realizes that the problems of peace are fully as complex as those of war. Enemies have become friends, friends enemies, and even the form of conflict has changed. What he cannot realize, however, is just how close the next conflict is. And when one of those new enemies readies a strike not only at America's territory, but at the heart of her economy, it is Ryan, with the help of CIA officers John Clark and Domingo Chavez, who must prepare an untested President to meet the challenge, if Ryan can only figure out how. For there is a debt of honor to be paid - and the price will be terrifyingly high. . .

Los enemigos se han convertido en amigos, los amigos en enemigos, e incluso la forma del conflicto ha cambiado. Sin embargo, lo que no puede comprender es cuán cerca está el próximo conflicto. Y cuando uno de esos nuevos enemigos prepara un ataque no solo contra el territorio estadounidense, sino también contra el corazón de su economía, es Ryan, con la ayuda de los oficiales de la CIA John Clark y Domingo Chávez, quien debe preparar a un presidente inexperto para afrontar el desafío, si Ryan logra descubrir cómo. title: The Grass Dancer
description: From the 1860s, when two lovers are separated by death, the cosmic drama of the two spirits desperately seeking to be reunited molds the lives and fates of their descendants, in a novel shaped by the lore of the Sioux. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780425159538 From the 1860s, when two lovers are separated by death, the cosmic drama of the two spirits desperately seeking to be reunited molds the lives and fates of their descendants, in a novel shaped by the lore of the Sioux. Reissue.
spanish_description: En la década de 1860, cuando dos amantes son separados por la muerte, el drama cósmico de dos espíritus que buscan desesperadamente reunirse moldea la vida y el destino de sus descendientes, en una novela inspirada en la tradición sioux. Reedición.

title: Hocus Pocus
description: Tarkington College, a small, exclusive college in upstate New York, is turned upside down when ten thousand prisoners from the maximum security prison across Lake Mohiga break out and head for the college
tagged_description: 9780425161296 Tarkington College, a small, exclusive college in upstate New York, is turned upside down when ten thousand prisoners from the maximum security prison across Lake Mohiga break out and head for the college
spanish_description: Tarkington College, una pequeña y exclusiva universidad en el norte del estado de Nueva York, se pone patas arriba cuando diez mil prisioneros de la prisión de máxima seguridad al otro lado del lago Mohiga se escapan y se dirigen a la universidad.

title: Virtual Vandals
description: Here comes a Clancy first: a new series of novels for young adults starring a team of troubleshooting teens--the Net Force Explorers--who know more about cutting edge technology than their teachers!
tagged_description: 9780425161739 Here comes a Clancy first: a new series of novels for young adults starring a team of troubleshooting teens--the Net Force Explorers--who know more about cutting edge technology than their teachers!
spanish_description: Aquí llega una primicia de Clancy: una nueva serie de novelas para adultos jóvenes protagonizada por un equipo de adolescentes solucionadores de problemas, los Net Force Explorers, que saben más sobre tecnología de vanguardia que sus profesores.

title: The Rapture of Canaan
description: Ninah Huff, the teenage granddaughter of the founder of an isolated religious community, causes controversy when she is discovered to be pregnant with what she claims is a holy child
tagged_description: 9780425162446 Ninah Huff, the teenage granddaughter of the founder of an isolated religious community, causes controversy when she is discovered to be pregnant with what she claims is a holy child
spanish_description: Ninah Huff, la nieta adolescente del fundador de una comunidad religiosa aislada, causa controversia cuando se descubre que está embarazada de lo que ella afirma es un niño santo.

title: One is the Loneliest Number
description: When fellow student Roddy L'Officier sabotages Maj Green's latest virtual simulation program, he is exiled by the rest of the Net Force Explorers, but the brilliant outcast has some other dangerous plans for them all. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425164174 When fellow student Roddy L'Officier sabotages Maj Green's latest virtual simulation program, he is exiled by the rest of the Net Force Explorers, but the brilliant outcast has some other dangerous plans for them all. Original.
spanish_description: Cuando su compañero de estudios Roddy L'Officier sabotea el último programa de simulación virtual de Maj Green, es exiliado por el resto de los Net Force Explorers, pero el brillante paria tiene otros planes peligrosos para todos ellos. Original.

title: Here on Earth
description: A middle-aged woman, along with her fifteen-year-old daughter, returns to her small Massachusetts hometown for the funeral of the housekeeper who raised her and finds herself thrust into the lives of the people she left behind. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425169698 A middle-aged woman, along with her fifteen-year-old daughter, returns to her small Massachusetts hometown for the funeral of the housekeeper who raised her and finds herself thrust into the lives of the people she left behind. Reprint.
spanish_description: Una mujer de mediana edad, acompañada de su hija de quince años, regresa a su pequeño pueblo natal de Massachusetts para el funeral de la criada que la crio y se ve inmersa en la vida de quienes dejó atrás. Reimpresión.

title: Divide and Conquer
description: When a mysterious cabal within the U.S. State Department causes tensions to erupt between Iran and Azerbaijan and plots to depose the President of the United States, Paul Hood and the Op-Center team must stop the conspiracy.
tagged_description: 9780425174807 When a mysterious cabal within the U.S. State Department causes tensions to erupt between Iran and Azerbaijan and plots to depose the President of the United States, Paul Hood and the Op-Center team must stop the conspiracy.
spanish_description: Cuando una misteriosa camarilla dentro del Departamento de Estado de EE. UU. provoca tensiones entre Irán y Azerbaiyán y conspira para derrocar al Presidente de los Estados Unidos, Paul Hood y el equipo del Op-Center deben detener la conspiración.

title: Breaking Point
description: While struggling to recover from a shattered personal life, Net Force Commander Alex Michaels races against time to find the culprits responsible for stealing plans to a top-secret atmospheric weapon that uses low-frequency wave generation to drive people mad. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425176931 While struggling to recover from a shattered personal life, Net Force Commander Alex Michaels races against time to find the culprits responsible for stealing plans to a top-secret atmospheric weapon that uses low-frequency wave generation to drive people mad. Original.
spanish_description: Mientras lucha por recuperarse de una vida personal destrozada, el comandante de la Fuerza de Red, Alex Michaels, corre contrarreloj para encontrar a los responsables del robo de los planos de un arma atmosférica ultrasecreta que genera ondas de baja frecuencia para enloquecer a la gente. Original.

title: The Raphael Affair
description: When a long-lost Raphael resurfaces, the painting triggers a chain of events that range from vandalism to murder, prompting an investigation by English art scholar Jonathan Argyll, who ends up on the run for his life. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425178928 When a long-lost Raphael resurfaces, the painting triggers a chain of events that range from vandalism to murder, prompting an investigation by English art scholar Jonathan Argyll, who ends up on the run for his life. Reprint.
spanish_description: Cuando un Rafael perdido hace mucho tiempo reaparece, la pintura desencadena una serie de acontecimientos que van desde el vandalismo hasta el asesinato, lo que da pie a una investigación por parte del erudito en arte inglés Jonathan Argyll, quien termina huyendo para salvar su vida. Reimpresión.

title: It's Not About the Bike
description: The champion cyclist recounts his diagnosis with cancer, the grueling treatments during which he was given a less than twenty percent chance for survival, his surprising victory in the 1999 Tour de France, and the birth of his son.
title_and_subtitle: It's Not About the Bike: My Journey Back to Life
tagged_description: 9780425179611 The champion cyclist recounts his diagnosis with cancer, the grueling treatments during which he was given a less than twenty percent chance for survival, his surprising victory in the 1999 Tour de France, and the birth of his son.
spanish_description: El ciclista campeón relata su diagnóstico de cáncer, los extenuantes tratamientos durante los cuales le dieron menos del veinte por ciento de posibilidades de sobrevivir, su sorprendente victoria en el Tour de Francia de 1999 y el nacimiento de su hijo.

title: Line of Control
description: When the military arm of Op-Center is sent to Kashmir to capture an Islamic terrorist who is fomenting rebellion against the Indian government, they find themselves caught in the middle of a war between India and Pakistan.
tagged_description: 9780425180051 When the military arm of Op-Center is sent to Kashmir to capture an Islamic terrorist who is fomenting rebellion against the Indian government, they find themselves caught in the middle of a war between India and Pakistan.
spanish_description: Cuando el brazo militar de Op-Center es enviado a Cachemira para capturar a un terrorista islámico que está fomentando la rebelión contra el gobierno indio, se encuentran atrapados en medio de una guerra entre India y Pakistán.

title: The Bear and the Dragon
description: In the wake of an assassination attempt on the SVR (former KGB) chairman, newly elected U.S. president Jack Ryan puts black ops specialist John Clark on the alert, only to have things complicated by dangerous forces in China.
tagged_description: 9780425180969 In the wake of an assassination attempt on the SVR (former KGB) chairman, newly elected U.S. president Jack Ryan puts black ops specialist John Clark on the alert, only to have things complicated by dangerous forces in China.
spanish_description: A raíz de un intento de asesinato del presidente del SVR (ex KGB), el recién elegido presidente de los EE. UU., Jack Ryan, pone en alerta al especialista en operaciones encubiertas John Clark, solo para que las cosas se compliquen por la presencia de fuerzas peligrosas en China.

title: Phantoms
description: A tale of an abandoned town and the unimaginable truth behind its silence... Now with a new afterword, Dean Koontz explains the impact Phantoms had on his career.
tagged_description: 9780425181102 A tale of an abandoned town and the unimaginable truth behind its silence... Now with a new afterword, Dean Koontz explains the impact Phantoms had on his career.
spanish_description: La historia de un pueblo abandonado y la inimaginable verdad detrás de su silencio... Ahora, con un nuevo epílogo, Dean Koontz explica el impacto que Phantoms tuvo en su carrera.

title: Strangers
description: A group of seemingly unrelated people experiences sensations of numbing terror and fear and, groping their way toward one another, discover their sinister, shared secrets in a chilling climax that changes their lives forever. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780425181119 A group of seemingly unrelated people experiences sensations of numbing terror and fear and, groping their way toward one another, discover their sinister, shared secrets in a chilling climax that changes their lives forever. Reissue.
spanish_description: Un grupo de personas aparentemente sin parentesco experimenta sensaciones de terror y miedo paralizantes y, a tientas, descubren sus siniestros secretos compartidos en un clímax escalofriante que cambia sus vidas para siempre. Reedición.

title: Stephen King's Danse Macabre
description: The best-selling author offers a subjective tour of favorite books, films, and television programs which have met his criteria for great horror, examines the attractions and satisfactions of horror stories, and recounts his own vital encounter with horror. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425181607 The best-selling author offers a subjective tour of favorite books, films, and television programs which have met his criteria for great horror, examines the attractions and satisfactions of horror stories, and recounts his own vital encounter with horror. Reprint.
spanish_description: El autor superventas ofrece un recorrido subjetivo por sus libros, películas y programas de televisión favoritos que cumplen con sus criterios de gran terror, examina los atractivos y las satisfacciones de las historias de terror y relata su propio encuentro vital con el terror. Reimpresión.

title: E
description: Examines the science and scientists who provided the backdrop to Einstein's influential 1905 discovery and offers an explanation of the equation from mathematical, historical, and scientific perspectives.
title_and_subtitle: E: A Biography of the World's Most Famous Equation
tagged_description: 9780425181645 Examines the science and scientists who provided the backdrop to Einstein's influential 1905 discovery and offers an explanation of the equation from mathematical, historical, and scientific perspectives.
spanish_description: Examina la ciencia y los científicos que proporcionaron el contexto para el influyente descubrimiento de Einstein en 1905 y ofrece una explicación de la ecuación desde perspectivas matemáticas, históricas y científicas.

title: Stardust of Yesterday
description: "Genevieve Buchanan inherited a castle -- and a ghost to go along with it. But Kendrick de Piaget was no typical ghost. He was a handsome and infuriatingly arrogant thirteenth-century knight. At first he wanted to frighten Genevieve, though she was more charmed than scared by his ghostly tricks. But when his thoughts turned to wooing her instead, Genevieve had to face her greatest fear: falling in love." -- from publisher's web site.
tagged_description: 9780425182383 "Genevieve Buchanan inherited a castle -- and a ghost to go along with it. But Kendrick de Piaget was no typical ghost. He was a handsome and infuriatingly arrogant thirteenth-century knight. At first he wanted to frighten Genevieve, though she was more charmed than scared by his ghostly tricks. But when his thoughts turned to wooing her instead, Genevieve had to face her greatest fear: falling in love." -- from publisher's web site.
spanish_description: Genevieve Buchanan heredó un castillo y, con él, un fantasma. Pero Kendrick de Piaget no era un fantasma cualquiera. Era un caballero del siglo XIII, apuesto y exasperantemente arrogante. Al principio, quiso asustar a Genevieve, aunque sus trucos fantasmales la cautivaron más que la asustaron. Pero cuando sus pensamientos se centraron en cortejarla, Genevieve tuvo que enfrentarse a su mayor miedo: enamorarse. -- del sitio web de la editorial.

title: Tom Clancy's Net Force
description: When a group of terrorists who call themselves "CyberNation," and consider themselves an independent virtual country, seize control of the net and bring down the world's computers, the Net Force springs into action.
tagged_description: 9780425182673 When a group of terrorists who call themselves "CyberNation," and consider themselves an independent virtual country, seize control of the net and bring down the world's computers, the Net Force springs into action.
spanish_description: Cuando un grupo de terroristas que se autodenominan "CyberNation" y se consideran un país virtual independiente toman el control de la red y derriban las computadoras del mundo, la Net Force entra en acción.

title: Chosen Prey
description: Hoping to use a supposedly straightforward case of murder to clear his mind, Deputy Chief Lucas Davenport finds himself matching wits with an ever-escalating serial killer, art history professor, congenial pervert, and sexual predator James Qatar.
tagged_description: 9780425182871 Hoping to use a supposedly straightforward case of murder to clear his mind, Deputy Chief Lucas Davenport finds himself matching wits with an ever-escalating serial killer, art history professor, congenial pervert, and sexual predator James Qatar.
spanish_description: Con la esperanza de utilizar un supuesto caso sencillo de asesinato para aclarar su mente, el subjefe Lucas Davenport se ve obligado a enfrentarse en combate con un asesino en serie en constante aumento, un profesor de historia del arte, un pervertido simpático y un depredador sexual, James Qatar.

title: Cloak and Dagger
description: Net Force Explorer Daniel Sanchez finds himself in a wealth of trouble when a game of hide-and-seek on the Web leads to a breach of confidential Net Force files involving the CIA, forcing the Explorers to find the real culprit and clear Daniel's name. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425183038 Net Force Explorer Daniel Sanchez finds himself in a wealth of trouble when a game of hide-and-seek on the Web leads to a breach of confidential Net Force files involving the CIA, forcing the Explorers to find the real culprit and clear Daniel's name. Original.
spanish_description: El explorador de Net Force, Daniel Sánchez, se ve envuelto en serios problemas cuando un juego de las escondidas en la web provoca una filtración de archivos confidenciales de Net Force que involucran a la CIA. Esto obliga a los exploradores a encontrar al verdadero culpable y limpiar el nombre de Daniel. Original.

title: Death Match
description: When the star of South Florida's spatball team is threatened by a ruthless gang of major bettors who stand to lose a fortune, Catie Murray and the Net Force Explorers delve into the cyber world to protect America's newest sports phenomenon. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425184486 When the star of South Florida's spatball team is threatened by a ruthless gang of major bettors who stand to lose a fortune, Catie Murray and the Net Force Explorers delve into the cyber world to protect America's newest sports phenomenon. Original.
spanish_description: Cuando la estrella del equipo de spatball del sur de Florida se ve amenazada por una despiadada banda de grandes apostadores que corren el riesgo de perder una fortuna, Catie Murray y los Net Force Explorers se adentran en el mundo cibernético para proteger al nuevo fenómeno deportivo de Estados Unidos. Original.

title: Picture Perfect
description: Falling madly in love and beginning what she believed would be the perfect marriage with Hollywood leading man Alex Rivers, renowned anthropologist Cassie Barret is heartbroken when their fairy-tale romance falls apart. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780425185506 Falling madly in love and beginning what she believed would be the perfect marriage with Hollywood leading man Alex Rivers, renowned anthropologist Cassie Barret is heartbroken when their fairy-tale romance falls apart. Reissue.
spanish_description: Tras enamorarse perdidamente y comenzar lo que creía que sería el matrimonio perfecto con el galán de Hollywood, Alex Rivers, la reconocida antropóloga Cassie Barret queda desconsolada cuando su romance de cuento de hadas se desmorona. Reedición.

title: Shadowland
description: Best friends Tom Flanagan and Del Nightingale, apprentices to a master magician, enter a dark realm of immeasurable evil, more ancient than death itself, where only one of them will survive.
tagged_description: 9780425188224 Best friends Tom Flanagan and Del Nightingale, apprentices to a master magician, enter a dark realm of immeasurable evil, more ancient than death itself, where only one of them will survive.
spanish_description: Los mejores amigos Tom Flanagan y Del Nightingale, aprendices de un maestro mago, ingresan a un reino oscuro de maldad inconmensurable, más antiguo que la muerte misma, donde solo uno de ellos sobrevivirá.

title: Floating Dragon
description: The quaint town of Hamptead is plunged into a nightmarish world of unspeakable horror when evil arrives in the form of two very different beings--one man-made and one supernatural. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780425189641 The quaint town of Hamptead is plunged into a nightmarish world of unspeakable horror when evil arrives in the form of two very different beings--one man-made and one supernatural. Reissue.
spanish_description: El pintoresco pueblo de Hamptead se sumerge en un mundo de pesadilla de horror indescriptible cuando el mal llega en la forma de dos seres muy diferentes: uno creado por el hombre y otro sobrenatural. Reedición.

title: Practical Magic
description: Sorcery is the legacy of Gillian and Sally Owens, a legacy they both try to escape until they realize their magic is a gift, not an affliction.
tagged_description: 9780425190371 Sorcery is the legacy of Gillian and Sally Owens, a legacy they both try to escape until they realize their magic is a gift, not an affliction.
spanish_description: La brujería es el legado de Gillian y Sally Owens, un legado del que ambas intentan escapar hasta que se dan cuenta de que su magia es un don, no una aflicción.

title: Sea of Fire
description: When a Singapore pirate is found in the Celebes Sea with radiation on his skin, the Op-Center team investigating nuclear disposal learns that a multinational corporation hired to dispose of nuclear waste is selling it to terrorists.
tagged_description: 9780425190913 When a Singapore pirate is found in the Celebes Sea with radiation on his skin, the Op-Center team investigating nuclear disposal learns that a multinational corporation hired to dispose of nuclear waste is selling it to terrorists.
spanish_description: Cuando un pirata de Singapur es encontrado en el Mar de Célebes con radiación en su piel, el equipo del Centro de Operaciones que investiga la eliminación de residuos nucleares descubre que una corporación multinacional contratada para eliminar residuos nucleares los está vendiendo a terroristas.

title: McNally's Alibi
description: Hired to locate the complete text of Truman Capote's "Answered Prayers," Archy McNally encounters a series of dead ends before finding the manuscript's owner murdered in a sleazy motel.
title_and_subtitle: McNally's Alibi: An Archy McNally Novel
tagged_description: 9780425191194 Hired to locate the complete text of Truman Capote's "Answered Prayers," Archy McNally encounters a series of dead ends before finding the manuscript's owner murdered in a sleazy motel.
spanish_description: Contratado para localizar el texto completo de "Oraciones contestadas" de Truman Capote, Archy McNally se topa con una serie de callejones sin salida antes de encontrar al dueño del manuscrito asesinado en un motel de mala muerte.

title: Lightning
description: Aided through many crises throughout her life by the almost miraculous intervention of a stranger, Laura Shane learns the nature of her awesome destiny when, on her thirtieth birthday, the stranger finally requests her help. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780425192030 Aided through many crises throughout her life by the almost miraculous intervention of a stranger, Laura Shane learns the nature of her awesome destiny when, on her thirtieth birthday, the stranger finally requests her help. Reissue.
spanish_description: Ayudada a superar muchas crisis a lo largo de su vida por la intervención casi milagrosa de un desconocido, Laura Shane descubre la naturaleza de su asombroso destino cuando, en su trigésimo cumpleaños, el desconocido finalmente solicita su ayuda. Reedición.

title: Goddess of the Sea
description: When Air Force Sergeant Christine Canady wishes for a little magic in her life, she is transported to a mystical realm where she takes the form of the legendary mermaid Undine, but when the waters become dangerous, Christine must seek safety on land and in the arms of a handsome knight. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425192795 When Air Force Sergeant Christine Canady wishes for a little magic in her life, she is transported to a mystical realm where she takes the form of the legendary mermaid Undine, but when the waters become dangerous, Christine must seek safety on land and in the arms of a handsome knight. Original.
spanish_description: Cuando la sargento de la Fuerza Aérea Christine Canady desea un poco de magia en su vida, es transportada a un reino místico donde toma la forma de la legendaria sirena Undine. Pero cuando las aguas se vuelven peligrosas, Christine debe buscar refugio en tierra firme, en los brazos de un apuesto caballero. Original.

title: The Sea Hunters II
description: Collects accounts of the underwater discoveries made by the author and his team of volunteers dedicated to the exploration of historic wrecks, including the tale of the ghost ship Mary Celeste, the Carpathia, and the Hunley.
tagged_description: 9780425193723 Collects accounts of the underwater discoveries made by the author and his team of volunteers dedicated to the exploration of historic wrecks, including the tale of the ghost ship Mary Celeste, the Carpathia, and the Hunley.
spanish_description: Recopila relatos de los descubrimientos submarinos realizados por el autor y su equipo de voluntarios dedicados a la exploración de naufragios históricos, incluida la historia del barco fantasma Mary Celeste, el Carpathia y el Hunley.

title: Raise the Titanic!
description: Two Russian spies and a violent hurricane hinder Dirk Pitt's herculean efforts to raise the R.M.S. Titanic and thereby salvage the world's only supply of a rare metal, needed for a secret American defense system. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780425194522 Two Russian spies and a violent hurricane hinder Dirk Pitt's herculean efforts to raise the R.M.S. Titanic and thereby salvage the world's only supply of a rare metal, needed for a secret American defense system. Reissue.
spanish_description: Dos espías rusos y un violento huracán obstaculizan los titánicos esfuerzos de Dirk Pitt por rescatar el RMS Titanic y así rescatar el único suministro mundial de un metal raro, necesario para un sistema de defensa secreto estadounidense. Reedición.

title: Field of Thirteen
description: A four-time Edgar Award winner presents a fast-paced collection of 13 tightly plotted tales featuring murder, mystery, and mayhem in the horse racing world. "Whether it's an elegy for a sports writer on the skids or the ballad of a Welsh groom and her social-climbing daughter, the stories linger long after you turn the page."--"Entertainment Weekly."
tagged_description: 9780425194997 A four-time Edgar Award winner presents a fast-paced collection of 13 tightly plotted tales featuring murder, mystery, and mayhem in the horse racing world. "Whether it's an elegy for a sports writer on the skids or the ballad of a Welsh groom and her social-climbing daughter, the stories linger long after you turn the page."--"Entertainment Weekly."
spanish_description: Un cuatro veces ganador del Premio Edgar presenta una colección trepidante de 13 relatos de tramas precisas que recorren el asesinato, el misterio y el caos en el mundo de las carreras de caballos. "Ya sea una elegía para un periodista deportivo en decadencia o la balada de un novio galés y su hija arribista, las historias perduran mucho después de pasar la página." --"Entertainment Weekly".

title: The Bad Place
description: After repeatedly waking up in strange places and not knowing how he arrived there, Frank Pollard enlists the help of Nick and Julie Dakota, a husband-and-wife detective team, to watch where he goes in his sleep. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780425195482 After repeatedly waking up in strange places and not knowing how he arrived there, Frank Pollard enlists the help of Nick and Julie Dakota, a husband-and-wife detective team, to watch where he goes in his sleep. Reissue.
spanish_description: Tras despertar repetidamente en lugares extraños sin saber cómo llegó allí, Frank Pollard recurre a Nick y Julie Dakota, un matrimonio de detectives, para vigilar adónde va mientras duerme. Reedición.

title: Slay Ride
description: A series of bizarre incidents befalls British investigator David Cleveland when he is sent to Norway to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of champion British jockey Robert Sherman. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780425196731 A series of bizarre incidents befalls British investigator David Cleveland when he is sent to Norway to uncover the truth behind the disappearance of champion British jockey Robert Sherman. Reissue.
spanish_description: Una serie de extraños incidentes azotan al investigador británico David Cleveland cuando es enviado a Noruega para descubrir la verdad tras la desaparición del campeón de jockey británico Robert Sherman. Reedición.

title: Jane's Warlord
description: On the trail of a sadistic killer, who has the ability to travel through time, reporter Jane Colby discovers she is destined to become the killer's next victim when Baran Arvid, a genetically engineered warrior from the future, arrives to protect her from harm. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425196847 On the trail of a sadistic killer, who has the ability to travel through time, reporter Jane Colby discovers she is destined to become the killer's next victim when Baran Arvid, a genetically engineered warrior from the future, arrives to protect her from harm. Original.
spanish_description: Tras la pista de un asesino sádico con la capacidad de viajar en el tiempo, la reportera Jane Colby descubre que está destinada a convertirse en su próxima víctima cuando Baran Arvid, un guerrero del futuro genéticamente modificado, llega para protegerla. Original.

title: Dirk Pitt
description: A mysterious ship sealed fast in a giant North Atlantic iceberg becomes the cause and focus of Air Force Major Dirk Pett's investigation into international conspiracy and terror.
tagged_description: 9780425197387 A mysterious ship sealed fast in a giant North Atlantic iceberg becomes the cause and focus of Air Force Major Dirk Pett's investigation into international conspiracy and terror.
spanish_description: Un misterioso barco sellado firmemente en un iceberg gigante del Atlántico Norte se convierte en la causa y el foco de la investigación del Mayor de la Fuerza Aérea Dirk Pett sobre conspiración y terrorismo internacional.

title: The Mediterranean Caper
description: Dirk Pitt responds to a call of distress and finds himself coping with a modern Greek goddess in a red bikini, a vast drug-smuggling ring, a still-active Nazi criminal, and a perilous undersea labyrinth.
tagged_description: 9780425197394 Dirk Pitt responds to a call of distress and finds himself coping with a modern Greek goddess in a red bikini, a vast drug-smuggling ring, a still-active Nazi criminal, and a perilous undersea labyrinth.
spanish_description: Dirk Pitt responde a un llamado de socorro y se encuentra enfrentándose a una diosa griega moderna en bikini rojo, una enorme red de tráfico de drogas, un criminal nazi aún activo y un peligroso laberinto submarino.

title: 10 Lb. Penalty
description: Entering the political arena as the trusted confidant of his politician father, ex-jockey Benedict Juliard finds himself the target of a vicious attack by his father's dangerous enemies, an assault that could not only destroy his own reputation but that of his father, a prospective prime minister. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780425197455 Entering the political arena as the trusted confidant of his politician father, ex-jockey Benedict Juliard finds himself the target of a vicious attack by his father's dangerous enemies, an assault that could not only destroy his own reputation but that of his father, a prospective prime minister. Reissue.
spanish_description: Al entrar en la arena política como confidente de su padre, el exjockey Benedict Juliard, se encuentra en el blanco de un feroz ataque por parte de los peligrosos enemigos de su padre, un asalto que podría destruir no solo su propia reputación, sino también la de su padre, un futuro primer ministro. Reedición.

title: Goddess of Spring
description: Making a bargain with the goddess Demeter to save herself from financial ruin, bakery owner Lina is transformed into Persephone, the Goddess of Spring, and must restore order to the Underworld, but her attraction to Hades endangers her mission. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425197493 Making a bargain with the goddess Demeter to save herself from financial ruin, bakery owner Lina is transformed into Persephone, the Goddess of Spring, and must restore order to the Underworld, but her attraction to Hades endangers her mission. Original.
spanish_description: Tras llegar a un acuerdo con la diosa Deméter para salvarse de la ruina financiera, Lina, dueña de una panadería, se transforma en Perséfone, la diosa de la primavera, y debe restaurar el orden en el Inframundo, pero su atracción por Hades pone en peligro su misión. Original.

title: Guilty Pleasures
description: Vampire hunter Anita Blake (known by the vampires she kills as "The Executioner") is hired by the most powerful vampire in town to find out who has been murdering vampires. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425197547 Vampire hunter Anita Blake (known by the vampires she kills as "The Executioner") is hired by the most powerful vampire in town to find out who has been murdering vampires. Reprint.
spanish_description: La cazadora de vampiros Anita Blake (conocida por los vampiros que mata como "La Verduga") es contratada por el vampiro más poderoso de la ciudad para descubrir quién ha estado asesinando vampiros. Reimpresión.

title: Odds Against
description: Depressed since the accident that ended his racing career, Sid Halley accepts a position at a detective agency, but only really comes out of his shell when he becomes part of a murder investigation. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425198001 Depressed since the accident that ended his racing career, Sid Halley accepts a position at a detective agency, but only really comes out of his shell when he becomes part of a murder investigation. Reprint.
spanish_description: Deprimido desde el accidente que puso fin a su carrera como piloto, Sid Halley acepta un puesto en una agencia de detectives, pero solo sale de su caparazón al involucrarse en una investigación de asesinato. Reimpresión.

title: Death's Acre
description: A leading forensic anthropologist traces his sometimes grisly work at his Tennessee "body farm" lab and cites his contributions to the investigations of several murder cases as well as his theories about such famous cases as the Lindbergh kidnapping and the mystery of the headless corpse. Reprint.
title_and_subtitle: Death's Acre: Inside the Legendary Forensic Lab-The Body Farm-Where The Dead Do Tell Tales
tagged_description: 9780425198322 A leading forensic anthropologist traces his sometimes grisly work at his Tennessee "body farm" lab and cites his contributions to the investigations of several murder cases as well as his theories about such famous cases as the Lindbergh kidnapping and the mystery of the headless corpse. Reprint.
spanish_description: Un destacado antropólogo forense rastrea su trabajo, a veces espeluznante, en su laboratorio de Tennessee, una "granja de cadáveres", y cita sus contribuciones a las investigaciones de varios casos de asesinato, así como sus teorías sobre casos tan famosos como el secuestro de Lindbergh y el misterio del cadáver decapitado. Reimpresión.

title: Pattern Recognition
description: Hired to investigate a mysterious video collection that has been appearing on the Internet, market research consultant Cayce Pollard realizes that there is more to the assignment when her computer is hacked. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425198681 Hired to investigate a mysterious video collection that has been appearing on the Internet, market research consultant Cayce Pollard realizes that there is more to the assignment when her computer is hacked. Reprint.
spanish_description: Contratada para investigar una misteriosa colección de videos que ha estado apareciendo en internet, la consultora de investigación de mercado Cayce Pollard se da cuenta de que la tarea esconde algo más cuando su computadora es hackeada. Reimpresión.

title: Blow Fly
description: Leaving Virginia in search of peace and quiet, Dr. Kay Scarpetta journeys to Florida, where a series of baffling murders entangles her in an international conspiracy that confronts her with the most unexpected circumstance of her life. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425198735 Leaving Virginia in search of peace and quiet, Dr. Kay Scarpetta journeys to Florida, where a series of baffling murders entangles her in an international conspiracy that confronts her with the most unexpected circumstance of her life. Reprint.
spanish_description: Tras abandonar Virginia en busca de paz y tranquilidad, la Dra. Kay Scarpetta viaja a Florida, donde una serie de asesinatos desconcertantes la enreda en una conspiración internacional que la enfrenta a la circunstancia más inesperada de su vida. Reimpresión.

title: Master of the Night
description: Hired to seduce gorgeous millionaire Reece Champion in order to gain entrance to a murderous organization, agent Erin Grayson gets more than she bargained for when she discovers that Reece is a vampire--and secret agent--who has his own agenda. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425198803 Hired to seduce gorgeous millionaire Reece Champion in order to gain entrance to a murderous organization, agent Erin Grayson gets more than she bargained for when she discovers that Reece is a vampire--and secret agent--who has his own agenda. Original.
spanish_description: Contratada para seducir al apuesto millonario Reece Champion y así poder entrar en una organización asesina, la agente Erin Grayson obtiene más de lo que esperaba cuando descubre que Reece es un vampiro (y agente secreto) con sus propios planes. Original.

title: Blood Sport
description: Reluctantly agreeing to locate a missing priceless breeding stallion for his employer, Gene Hawkins suddenly finds himself the target of millionaire Dave Teller's socialite wife, as he falls in love with his own boss's daughter and becomes the prey of a vicious gang of horse thieves. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425199169 Reluctantly agreeing to locate a missing priceless breeding stallion for his employer, Gene Hawkins suddenly finds himself the target of millionaire Dave Teller's socialite wife, as he falls in love with his own boss's daughter and becomes the prey of a vicious gang of horse thieves. Reprint.
spanish_description: Gene Hawkins, a regañadientes, accede a buscar un semental reproductor desaparecido de incalculable valor para su empleador. De repente, se convierte en el objetivo de la esposa de la alta sociedad del millonario Dave Teller, al enamorarse de la hija de su jefe y convertirse en presa de una despiadada banda de ladrones de caballos. Reimpresión.

title: Trojan Odyssey
description: Underwater adventurer Dirk Pitt and the NUMA crew investigate a black tide infesting the ocean off Nicaragua, a study complicated by the discovery of a mysterious artifact, a powerful storm, and a conspiracy.
tagged_description: 9780425199329 Underwater adventurer Dirk Pitt and the NUMA crew investigate a black tide infesting the ocean off Nicaragua, a study complicated by the discovery of a mysterious artifact, a powerful storm, and a conspiracy.
spanish_description: El aventurero submarino Dirk Pitt y la tripulación de NUMA investigan una marea negra que infesta el océano frente a Nicaragua, un estudio complicado por el descubrimiento de un misterioso artefacto, una poderosa tormenta y una conspiración.

title: The Glass House
description: London's high society goes to the Glass House to indulge their vices, and when one of them is found floating in the Thames, Captain Lacey uncovers jealousy and murder, as well as a few secrets of his own, while searching for justice. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425199435 London's high society goes to the Glass House to indulge their vices, and when one of them is found floating in the Thames, Captain Lacey uncovers jealousy and murder, as well as a few secrets of his own, while searching for justice. Original.
spanish_description: La alta sociedad londinense acude a la Casa de Cristal para satisfacer sus vicios, y cuando uno de ellos es encontrado flotando en el Támesis, el capitán Lacey descubre celos y asesinatos, además de algunos secretos propios, mientras busca justicia. Original.

title: Break in
description: Successful steeplechase jockey Christmas "Kit" Fielding finds himself attacked, chased, kidnapped, and knifed when he comes to the aid of his twin sister Holly and her husband, Bobby Allardeck, two star-crossed lovers caught in the middle of a long-time feud between equestrian families. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425199930 Successful steeplechase jockey Christmas "Kit" Fielding finds himself attacked, chased, kidnapped, and knifed when he comes to the aid of his twin sister Holly and her husband, Bobby Allardeck, two star-crossed lovers caught in the middle of a long-time feud between equestrian families. Reprint.
spanish_description: El exitoso jinete de carreras de obstáculos Christmas "Kit" Fielding se ve atacado, perseguido, secuestrado y apuñalado al acudir en ayuda de su hermana gemela Holly y su esposo, Bobby Allardeck, dos amantes desventurados atrapados en medio de una larga disputa entre familias ecuestres. Reimpresión.

title: Murder on the Orient Express
description: On a three-day journey through the snowbound Balkan hills, Hercule Poirot must weed through an array of international suspects to find the passenger who murdered a gangster on the Orient Express.
title_and_subtitle: Murder on the Orient Express: A Hercule Poirot Mystery
tagged_description: 9780425200452 On a three-day journey through the snowbound Balkan hills, Hercule Poirot must weed through an array of international suspects to find the passenger who murdered a gangster on the Orient Express.
spanish_description: En un viaje de tres días a través de las nevadas colinas de los Balcanes, Hércules Poirot debe examinar a una serie de sospechosos internacionales para encontrar al pasajero que asesinó a un gángster en el Orient Express.

title: The Magyar Venus
description: The discovery of a 25,000-year-old archaeological treasure, a rekindled romance, and a suspicious suicide send Toronto antiques dealer Lara McClintoch on a quest to the city of Budapest. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425201541 The discovery of a 25,000-year-old archaeological treasure, a rekindled romance, and a suspicious suicide send Toronto antiques dealer Lara McClintoch on a quest to the city of Budapest. Reprint.
spanish_description: El descubrimiento de un tesoro arqueológico de 25.000 años de antigüedad, un romance reavivado y un suicidio sospechoso llevan a Lara McClintoch, anticuaria de Toronto, en una búsqueda hacia la ciudad de Budapest. Reimpresión.

title: Goddess of Light
description: When Artemis and Apollo are sent to Las Vegas where they must grant the wish of interior designer Pamela Smythe, who longs for a man with god-like qualities, Artemis dares Apollo to become Pamela's dream man, making her innermost desires become a reality. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425201961 When Artemis and Apollo are sent to Las Vegas where they must grant the wish of interior designer Pamela Smythe, who longs for a man with god-like qualities, Artemis dares Apollo to become Pamela's dream man, making her innermost desires become a reality. Original.
spanish_description: Cuando Artemisa y Apolo son enviados a Las Vegas, donde deben conceder el deseo de la diseñadora de interiores Pamela Smythe, quien anhela un hombre con cualidades divinas, Artemisa reta a Apolo a convertirse en el hombre soñado de Pamela, haciendo realidad sus deseos más íntimos. Original.

title: Master of the Moon
description: While hunting a powerful female vampire who is wreaking havoc in a small South Carolina town, Diana London, a werewolf, encounters Llyr Galatyn, the king of Cachamwri Sidhe, who makes all of her erotic fantasies come true. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425203576 While hunting a powerful female vampire who is wreaking havoc in a small South Carolina town, Diana London, a werewolf, encounters Llyr Galatyn, the king of Cachamwri Sidhe, who makes all of her erotic fantasies come true. Original.
spanish_description: Mientras persigue a una poderosa vampiresa que siembra el caos en un pequeño pueblo de Carolina del Sur, Diana London, una mujer lobo, se encuentra con Llyr Galatyn, el rey de Cachamwri Sidhe, quien hace realidad todas sus fantasías eróticas. Original.

title: Hideaway
description: When Hatch Harrison is brought back to life in an ambulance, his second chance turns into a nightmarish quest to squelch the evil he brought back with him from the afterlife. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780425203897 When Hatch Harrison is brought back to life in an ambulance, his second chance turns into a nightmarish quest to squelch the evil he brought back with him from the afterlife. Reissue.
spanish_description: Cuando Hatch Harrison vuelve a la vida en una ambulancia, su segunda oportunidad se convierte en una pesadilla para acabar con el mal que trajo consigo del más allá. Reedición.

title: Lost City
description: When an enzyme capable of prolonging life is discovered deep beneath the North Atlantic, NUMA Special Assignments Team leader Kurt Austin and his colleague, Joe Zavala, investigate a killer who is targeting the enzyme's harvesters and researchers. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425204191 When an enzyme capable of prolonging life is discovered deep beneath the North Atlantic, NUMA Special Assignments Team leader Kurt Austin and his colleague, Joe Zavala, investigate a killer who is targeting the enzyme's harvesters and researchers. Reprint.
spanish_description: Cuando se descubre una enzima capaz de prolongar la vida en las profundidades del Atlántico Norte, Kurt Austin, líder del Equipo de Asignaciones Especiales de la NUMA, y su colega Joe Zavala investigan a un asesino que ataca a los recolectores e investigadores de la enzima. Reimpresión.

title: Black Wind
description: In the final days of World War II, the Japanese launch two submarines carrying a new strain of a deadly virus to the west coast of the United States, but years after the subs are lost at sea, someone plots to use their deadly cargo.
tagged_description: 9780425204238 In the final days of World War II, the Japanese launch two submarines carrying a new strain of a deadly virus to the west coast of the United States, but years after the subs are lost at sea, someone plots to use their deadly cargo.
spanish_description: En los últimos días de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, los japoneses lanzan dos submarinos que transportan una nueva cepa de un virus mortal a la costa oeste de los Estados Unidos, pero años después de que los submarinos se pierden en el mar, alguien planea utilizar su carga mortal.

title: Dark Watch
description: When Japanese shipping magnates whose fortunes are being threatened by brutal pirates in the waters of Southeast Asia turn to Captain Juan Cabrillo for assistance, he soon learns that the pirates' predations hide a deadly international conspiracy--a scheme of death and slavery. Original. 750,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780425205594 When Japanese shipping magnates whose fortunes are being threatened by brutal pirates in the waters of Southeast Asia turn to Captain Juan Cabrillo for assistance, he soon learns that the pirates' predations hide a deadly international conspiracy--a scheme of death and slavery. Original. 750,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Cuando los magnates navieros japoneses, cuyas fortunas se ven amenazadas por brutales piratas en las aguas del sudeste asiático, recurren al capitán Juan Cabrillo en busca de ayuda, este pronto descubre que las depredaciones de los piratas esconden una mortífera conspiración internacional: un plan de muerte y esclavitud. Original. Primera impresión: 750.000 ejemplares.

title: Shakespeare's Landlord
description: While trying to prove her innocence in the murder of her landlord, Lily Bard, karate student and cleaning service proprietor, finds plenty of skeletons in the closets of Shakespeare, Arkansas. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425206867 While trying to prove her innocence in the murder of her landlord, Lily Bard, karate student and cleaning service proprietor, finds plenty of skeletons in the closets of Shakespeare, Arkansas. Reprint.
spanish_description: Mientras intenta demostrar su inocencia en el asesinato de su casero, Lily Bard, estudiante de karate y propietaria de un servicio de limpieza, encuentra numerosos secretos ocultos en los armarios de Shakespeare, Arkansas. Reimpresión.

title: Captive Dreams
description: Sisters Celeste and Corinne Carson, each a best-selling author with her own fantasy-fulfilling hero, get more than they had bargained for when their "fictional" heroes--Jarred, a futuristic conqueror, and Mykhayl, a barbarian warrior of the past--worried about being written off, decide to kidnap their authors and imprison them in the seductive worlds that they created in their books. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425207758 Sisters Celeste and Corinne Carson, each a best-selling author with her own fantasy-fulfilling hero, get more than they had bargained for when their "fictional" heroes--Jarred, a futuristic conqueror, and Mykhayl, a barbarian warrior of the past--worried about being written off, decide to kidnap their authors and imprison them in the seductive worlds that they created in their books. Original.
spanish_description: Las hermanas Celeste y Corinne Carson, cada una autora de éxito con su propio héroe que cumple fantasías, obtienen más de lo que esperaban cuando sus héroes "ficticios" —Jarred, un conquistador futurista, y Mykhayl, un guerrero bárbaro del pasado—, preocupados por ser descartados, deciden secuestrar a sus autores y encarcelarlos en los seductores mundos que crearon en sus libros. Original.

title: Danse Macabre
description: Anita Blake is worried that her careers as a Federal Marshal who raises the dead and as a vampire executioner may be jeopardized when she realizes that she may be pregnant--and the father could be a vampire, a werewolf, or someone else entirely. 300,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780425207970 Anita Blake is worried that her careers as a Federal Marshal who raises the dead and as a vampire executioner may be jeopardized when she realizes that she may be pregnant--and the father could be a vampire, a werewolf, or someone else entirely. 300,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Anita Blake está preocupada de que sus carreras como alguacil federal que resucita a los muertos y como verdugo de vampiros puedan correr peligro cuando se da cuenta de que puede estar embarazada y que el padre podría ser un vampiro, un hombre lobo o alguien completamente diferente. Primera impresión: 300.000 copias.

title: Goddess of the Rose
description: This fourth novel in Cast's Goddess Summoning series retells the classic "Beauty and the Beast," as a young high priestess must remove a curse from the Rose Realm, waking the goddess Hecate's guardian beast from his permanent slumber. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425208915 This fourth novel in Cast's Goddess Summoning series retells the classic "Beauty and the Beast," as a young high priestess must remove a curse from the Rose Realm, waking the goddess Hecate's guardian beast from his permanent slumber. Original.
spanish_description: Esta cuarta novela de la serie Invocación de Diosas de Cast relata el clásico "La Bella y la Bestia", donde una joven suma sacerdotisa debe eliminar una maldición del Reino de las Rosas, despertando a la bestia guardiana de la diosa Hécate de su letargo eterno. Original.

title: Master of Swords
description: Gawain, a virile vampire knight, vows to prove to witch Lark McClure that not all vampires are violent and out for blood, while dealing with a relentless killer who wants them both destroyed. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425209219 Gawain, a virile vampire knight, vows to prove to witch Lark McClure that not all vampires are violent and out for blood, while dealing with a relentless killer who wants them both destroyed. Original.
spanish_description: Gawain, un caballero vampiro viril, jura demostrarle a la bruja Lark McClure que no todos los vampiros son violentos y buscan sangre, mientras lidia con un asesino implacable que quiere destruirlos a ambos. Original.

title: Boys That Bite
description: Bitten by a vampire after being mistaken for her Goth twin sister, Rayne, sixteen-year-old Sunny is in a race against time as she tries to prevent herself from becoming a vampire permanently.
tagged_description: 9780425209424 Bitten by a vampire after being mistaken for her Goth twin sister, Rayne, sixteen-year-old Sunny is in a race against time as she tries to prevent herself from becoming a vampire permanently.
spanish_description: Mordida por un vampiro después de ser confundida con su hermana gemela gótica, Rayne, Sunny, de dieciséis años, está en una carrera contra el tiempo mientras intenta evitar convertirse en vampiro de forma permanente.

title: Shadow of the Moon
description: Samantha Carpenter must join forces with reporter--and werewolf--Lance Marshall to find the truth surrounding her sister's mysterious coma by gaining entrance to a secretive club called The Castle, where they, while searching for answers, stumble upon a dark evil, and a passion like no other. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425209615 Samantha Carpenter must join forces with reporter--and werewolf--Lance Marshall to find the truth surrounding her sister's mysterious coma by gaining entrance to a secretive club called The Castle, where they, while searching for answers, stumble upon a dark evil, and a passion like no other. Original.
spanish_description: Samantha Carpenter debe unir fuerzas con el reportero (y hombre lobo) Lance Marshall para descubrir la verdad sobre el misterioso coma de su hermana. Para ello, acceden a un club secreto llamado El Castillo. Allí, mientras buscan respuestas, se topan con un oscuro mal y una pasión sin igual. Original.

title: Steamed
description: Known in local chatrooms as GourmetGirl, Chloe Carter, a food connoisseur and expert in failed romances, continues her quest to find the perfect man, but a blind date with a fellow food lover goes horribly wrong when he is stabbed to death. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425210383 Known in local chatrooms as GourmetGirl, Chloe Carter, a food connoisseur and expert in failed romances, continues her quest to find the perfect man, but a blind date with a fellow food lover goes horribly wrong when he is stabbed to death. Reprint.
spanish_description: Conocida en los chats locales como GourmetGirl, Chloe Carter, una experta en gastronomía y experta en romances fallidos, continúa su búsqueda del hombre perfecto, pero una cita a ciegas con un compañero amante de la comida sale terriblemente mal cuando él es apuñalado hasta la muerte. Reimpresión.

title: Rat Race
description: Assigned to fly four racing buffs to the track, pilot Matt Shore is forced to make an emergency landing, and he soon finds out that the mob has been tampering with the horseracing industry. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425210765 Assigned to fly four racing buffs to the track, pilot Matt Shore is forced to make an emergency landing, and he soon finds out that the mob has been tampering with the horseracing industry. Reprint.
spanish_description: Asignado a llevar a cuatro aficionados a las carreras a la pista, el piloto Matt Shore se ve obligado a realizar un aterrizaje de emergencia y pronto descubre que la mafia ha estado manipulando la industria hípica. Reimpresión.

title: Mysteria
description: Four sensual tales center around Mysteria, a magical place where the supernatural has coexisted peacefully with the mortal world until the bewitching ladies of this realm unleash a campaign of seduction that will be talked about for centuries.
tagged_description: 9780425211069 Four sensual tales center around Mysteria, a magical place where the supernatural has coexisted peacefully with the mortal world until the bewitching ladies of this realm unleash a campaign of seduction that will be talked about for centuries.
spanish_description: Cuatro relatos sensuales se centran en Mysteria, un lugar mágico donde lo sobrenatural ha coexistido pacíficamente con el mundo mortal hasta que las encantadoras damas de este reino desatan una campaña de seducción de la que se hablará durante siglos.

title: Skeleton Coast
description: Juan Cabrillo and the Oregon crew rescue beautiful Sloane Macintyre when her boat is attacked off the African coast, and face a deranged militant who plans to launch a devastating force of nature against those who oppose him.
tagged_description: 9780425211892 Juan Cabrillo and the Oregon crew rescue beautiful Sloane Macintyre when her boat is attacked off the African coast, and face a deranged militant who plans to launch a devastating force of nature against those who oppose him.
spanish_description: Juan Cabrillo y la tripulación de Oregon rescatan a la bella Sloane Macintyre cuando su barco es atacado en la costa africana, y se enfrentan a un militante trastornado que planea lanzar una fuerza devastadora de la naturaleza contra aquellos que se le oponen.

title: Strange Candy
description: A collection of short fiction features "The Girl Who Was Infatuated with Death," an Anita Blake, Vampire Hunter story, as well as "House of Wizards," "Stealing Souls," and "Those Who Seek Forgiveness," a never-before-published Anita Blake tale.
tagged_description: 9780425212011 A collection of short fiction features "The Girl Who Was Infatuated with Death," an Anita Blake, Vampire Hunter story, as well as "House of Wizards," "Stealing Souls," and "Those Who Seek Forgiveness," a never-before-published Anita Blake tale.
spanish_description: Una colección de cuentos cortos incluye "La chica que estaba enamorada de la muerte", una historia de Anita Blake, Cazadora de vampiros, así como "La casa de los magos", "Robar almas" y "Aquellos que buscan el perdón", un cuento inédito de Anita Blake.

title: Bit the Jackpot
description: Tired of keeping tabs on his boss's wife and her female entourage, vampire Seamus Fox, the campaign manager for the Vampire Nation presidential candidate, finds himself falling for the enigmatic Cara Kim, a sultry but shy stripper who dances behind a screen to hide her identity. By the author of High Stakes. Original. 30,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780425212134 Tired of keeping tabs on his boss's wife and her female entourage, vampire Seamus Fox, the campaign manager for the Vampire Nation presidential candidate, finds himself falling for the enigmatic Cara Kim, a sultry but shy stripper who dances behind a screen to hide her identity. By the author of High Stakes. Original. 30,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Cansado de vigilar a la esposa de su jefe y a su séquito femenino, el vampiro Seamus Fox, director de campaña del candidato presidencial de la Nación Vampiro, se enamora de la enigmática Cara Kim, una stripper sensual pero tímida que baila tras un biombo para ocultar su identidad. Del autor de High Stakes. Original. Primera edición con 30.000 ejemplares.

title: Prince of Ice
description: Xishi, a courtesan trained in the sensual arts, finds herself torn between love and duty when Corum, the Prince of Ice, and a man from her past, becomes her new owner, drawing her into a forbidden world where betrayal, lust, intrigue, and passion could cost them their lives. Original.
title_and_subtitle: Prince of Ice: A Tale of the Demon World
tagged_description: 9780425212592 Xishi, a courtesan trained in the sensual arts, finds herself torn between love and duty when Corum, the Prince of Ice, and a man from her past, becomes her new owner, drawing her into a forbidden world where betrayal, lust, intrigue, and passion could cost them their lives. Original.
spanish_description: Xishi, una cortesana entrenada en las artes sensuales, se debate entre el amor y el deber cuando Corum, el Príncipe de Hielo, y un hombre de su pasado, se convierte en su nuevo dueño, arrastrándola a un mundo prohibido donde la traición, la lujuria, la intriga y la pasión podrían costarles la vida. Original.

title: Checkmate
description: Third Echelon special operative Sam Fisher is pitted against one of the greatest enemies of the free world when a cargo freighter, armed with radioactive material, heads straight for the U.S. coast, while another strike renders a small New Mexico town helpless due to radiation poisoning. Original.
tagged_description: 9780425212783 Third Echelon special operative Sam Fisher is pitted against one of the greatest enemies of the free world when a cargo freighter, armed with radioactive material, heads straight for the U.S. coast, while another strike renders a small New Mexico town helpless due to radiation poisoning. Original.
spanish_description: El agente especial de Third Echelon, Sam Fisher, se enfrenta a uno de los mayores enemigos del mundo libre cuando un carguero, armado con material radiactivo, se dirige directo a la costa estadounidense, mientras que otro ataque deja a un pequeño pueblo de Nuevo México indefenso debido al envenenamiento por radiación. Original.

title: Shakespeare's Champion
description: Lily Bard, a cleaning lady and karate student in Shakespeare, Arkansas, would just like to live quietly, but she is forced to turn sleuth again when a man's body is found at the local gym with a barbell across his throat. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780425213100 Lily Bard, a cleaning lady and karate student in Shakespeare, Arkansas, would just like to live quietly, but she is forced to turn sleuth again when a man's body is found at the local gym with a barbell across his throat. Reprint.
spanish_description: Lily Bard, una empleada de limpieza y estudiante de karate en Shakespeare, Arkansas, simplemente desearía vivir tranquilamente, pero se ve obligada a volver a la investigación cuando encuentran el cadáver de un hombre en el gimnasio local con una barra en la garganta. Reimpresión.

title: Cause of Death
description: The mysterious death of diver Ted Eddings, an investigative reporter, and the murder of a morgue assistant driving her car lead medical examiner Kay Scarpetta, her niece, and police captain Pete Marino on the trail of a deadly supremacist group.
tagged_description: 9780425213384 The mysterious death of diver Ted Eddings, an investigative reporter, and the murder of a morgue assistant driving her car lead medical examiner Kay Scarpetta, her niece, and police captain Pete Marino on the trail of a deadly supremacist group.
spanish_description: La misteriosa muerte del buzo Ted Eddings, un periodista de investigación, y el asesinato de un asistente de la morgue que conducía su coche llevan a la médica forense Kay Scarpetta, a su sobrina y al capitán de policía Pete Marino a la búsqueda de un grupo supremacista mortal.

title: Over the Moon

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets (Book 2)
description: In Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets, the summer after Harry’s first year at Hogwarts has been his worst summer ever… the Dursleys more distant and horrible than ever before. But just as he’s packing his bags to return to school, a creature named Dobby the house-elf announces that if Harry goes back to Hogwarts, disaster will strike. And it turns out, Dobby is right. Harry and Ron miss the Hogwarts Express, so they fly to school in a blue Ford Anglia, crash landing in the notorious Whomping Willow. Soon other worries accumulate: the outrageously stuck-up new professor Gilderoy Lockhart; a ghost named Moaning Myrtle, who haunts the girls' bathroom; the strange behavior of Ron's little sister, Ginny Weasley; rumors about the "Chamber of Secrets," a cavern buried deep below Hogwarts; and a magical diary owned by Tom Riddle, a Hogwarts student of long ago. Harry is also shocked to discover that he can speak Parseltongue, the language of snakes - a rare ability that Lord Voldemort also possessed - and that anti-Muggle prejudice exists in the Wizarding world, even affecting Harry's friend Hermione. But all of these seem like minor concerns when someone starts turning Hogwarts students to stone: an evildoer said to be the fearsome Heir of Salazar Slytherin, on of the founders of the school. Could it be Draco Malfoy, Harry's most poisonous rival? Could it be Hagrid whose mysterious past is finally told? Or could it be the one person everyone at Hogwarts most suspects: Harry Potter himself?

Pero justo cuando está preparando sus maletas para volver al colegio, una criatura llamada Dobby, el elfo doméstico, anuncia que si Harry regresa a Hogwarts, ocurrirá un desastre. Y resulta que Dobby tiene razón. Harry y Ron pierden el Expreso de Hogwarts, así que vuelan al colegio en un Ford Anglia azul, donde se estrellan en el famoso Sauce Boxeador. Pronto se acumulan otras preocupaciones: el nuevo profesor Gilderoy Lockhart, escandalosamente estirado; un fantasma llamado Myrtle la Llorona, que ronda el baño de chicas; el extraño comportamiento de la hermana pequeña de Ron, Ginny Weasley; rumores sobre la "Cámara Secreta", una caverna enterrada en las profundidades de Hogwarts; y un diario mágico propiedad de Tom Riddle, un antiguo estudiante de Hogwarts. Harry también se sorprende al descubrir que puede hablar pársel, el idioma de las serpientes (una habilidad poco común que Lord Voldemort también poseía) y que existen prejuicios antimuggles en el mundo mágico, que incluso afectan a Hermione, la amiga de Harry. Pero todo esto parece una preocupación menor cuando alguien empieza a convertir en piedra a los estudiantes de Hogwarts: un malvado del que se dice que es el temible heredero de Salazar Slytherin, uno de los fundadores del colegio. ¿Podría ser Draco Malfoy, el rival más venenoso de Harry? ¿Podría ser Hagrid, cuyo misterioso pasado finalmente se revela? ¿O podría ser la persona de la que todos en Hogwarts más sospechan: el propio Harry Potter?

title: Mary, Queen of Scots, Queen Without a Country
description: Readers take a step back in time to 16th-century France in this year-long diary of adolescent Mary, Queen of Scots, who has fled from homeland to the Court of her betrothed in France. Mary is only nine months old when she is crowned Queen of Scotland succeeding her father King James V. Because of political conflicts, she is forced to be separated from her mother and her country from the age of five. For the benefit of forging an alliance with France, the youngster is betrothed to Francis, the son of King Henry ll of France and his wife, the vicious and jealous Queen Catherine de Medici. Mary is sent to France to live in their care until she is old enough for the marriage to take place. It is at their home, the beautiful Chateau St. Germaine, that we first meet the irresistibly charming Mary at 11 years old. Keenly intelligent, she excels academically, and shows a talent for dance, music and poetry. She's an expert horsewoman, skilled at archery and hawking.

María tenía solo nueve meses cuando fue coronada reina de Escocia, sucediendo a su padre, el rey Jacobo V. Debido a conflictos políticos, se vio obligada a separarse de su madre y su país desde los cinco años. Para forjar una alianza con Francia, la joven se comprometió con Francisco, hijo del rey Enrique II de Francia y su esposa, la cruel y celosa reina Catalina de Médici. María fue enviada a Francia para vivir bajo su cuidado hasta que tuviera la edad suficiente para el matrimonio. Fue en su hogar, el hermoso Château Saint-Germain, donde conocimos por primera vez a la irresistiblemente encantadora María a los 11 años. De gran inteligencia, destaca académicamente y muestra talento para la danza, la música y la poesía. Es una experta amazona, experta en tiro con arco y cetrería.

title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix (Book 5)
description: In Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix, Lord Voldemort has returned to the Wizarding world, presenting a threat that neither the magical government nor the authorities at Hogwarts can stop. In response to his reappearance, Dumbledore reactivates the Order of the Phoenix, a secret society which works to defeat the Dark Lord's minions and protect his targets—especially Harry Potter. But Harry doesn’t want to be protected. Even as the Ministry of Magic denies his claims, The Daily Prophet discredits him, and even Dumbledore won’t look him in the eye, Harry grows more and more determined to fight his lifelong enemy Voldemort—if only he had the “weapon” the Order is guarding. In the meantime, he visits his godfather at his ghoulish London home, Grimmauld Place, and learns more about Voldemort’s deep reach into Wizarding history and the Wizarding world. Back at Hogwarts, Harry must deal with a Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher with a personality like poisoned honey; a surprising new member of the Gryffindor Quidditch team; the possibility of his first real romance; and the looming nightmare of the Ordinary Wizarding Level exams. He’s haunted by dreams of a heavy door at the end of a silent corridor, and a vision of his father and the young Severus Snape that changes everything he thought he knew about them. Even the joy of working with "Dumbledore's Army" -a group of Hogwart's students dedicated to defeating Voldemort- can't dispel the gathering darkness. Soon Harry will discover the true depth and strength of his friends; their boundless loyalty and unbearable sacrifices. His fate depends on them all.

Even as the Ministry of Magic denies his claims, The Daily Prophet discredits him, and even Dumbledore won’t look him in the eye, Harry grows more and more determined to fight his lifelong enemy Voldemort—if only he had the “weapon” the Order is guarding. In the meantime, he visits his godfather at his ghoulish London home, Grimmauld Place, and learns more about Voldemort’s deep reach into Wizarding history and the Wizarding world. Back at Hogwarts, Harry must deal with a Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher with a personality like poisoned honey; a surprising new member of the Gryffindor Quidditch team; the possibility of his first real romance; and the looming nightmare of the Ordinary Wizarding Level exams. He’s haunted by dreams of a heavy door at the end of a silent corridor, and a vision of his father and the young Severus Snape that changes everything he thought he knew about them. Even the joy of working with "Dumbledore's Army" -a group of Hogwart's students dedicated to defeating Voldemort- can't dispel the gathering darkness. Soon Harry will discover the true depth and strength of his friends; their boundless loyalty and unbearable sacrifices. His fate depends on them all.
spanish_description: En Harry Potter y la Orden del Fénix, Lord Voldemort ha regresado al mundo mágico, presentando una amenaza que ni el gobierno mágico ni las autoridades de Hogwarts pueden detener. En respuesta a su reaparición, Dumbledore reactiva la Orden del Fénix, una sociedad secreta que trabaja para derrotar a los secuaces del Señor Tenebroso y proteger a sus objetivos, especialmente a Harry Potter. Pero Harry no quiere ser protegido. Incluso cuando el Ministerio de Magia niega sus afirmaciones, El Profeta lo desacredita, e incluso Dumbledore no lo mira a los ojos, Harry se vuelve cada vez más decidido a luchar contra su enemigo de toda la vida, Voldemort, si tan solo tuviera el "arma" que la Orden está protegiendo. Mientras tanto, visita a su padrino en su macabra casa de Londres, Grimmauld Place, y aprende más sobre el profundo alcance de Voldemort en la historia y el mundo mágico. De vuelta en Hogwarts, Harry debe lidiar con un profesor de Defensa Contra las Artes Oscuras con una personalidad como miel envenenada; Un sorprendente nuevo miembro del equipo de quidditch de Gryffindor; la posibilidad de su primer romance real; y la inminente pesadilla de los exámenes de nivel de mago ordinario. title: Anacaona, Golden Flower
description: Edwidge Danticat, the award-winning, best-selling author of THE FARMING OF BONES and KRIK? KRAK! offers a powerful addition to The Royal Diaries series with the story of Haiti's heroic queen Anacaona. With her signature narrative grace, Edwidge Danticat brings Haiti's beautiful queen Anacaona to life. Queen Anacaona was the wife of one of her island's rulers, and a composer of songs and poems, making her popular among her people. Haiti was relatively quiet until the Spanish conquistadors discovered the island and began to settle there in 1492. The Spaniards treated the natives very cruelly, and when the natives revolted, the Spanish governor of Haiti ordered the arrests of several native nobles, including Anacaona, who was eventually captured and executed, to the horror of her people.
