spanish_description: Se necesita mucho para perturbar a Bonnie Winter, una esposa y madre trabajadora cuyo trabajo es limpiar escenas del crimen, mientras lidia con los horrores de lo que las personas se hacen a diario, en esta escalofriante novela corta que explora la amenaza oculta en la vida cotidiana. Original.

title: Dead Sleep
description: A mysterious series of paintings in a Hong Kong art museum, including one featuring a woman who bears a striking resemblance to her, draws photojournalist Jordan Glass into a painful search for the murderer of her twin sister, killed one year earlier, as she becomes embroiled in a deadly duel with the anonymous killer who knows all too much about her. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451206527 A mysterious series of paintings in a Hong Kong art museum, including one featuring a woman who bears a striking resemblance to her, draws photojournalist Jordan Glass into a painful search for the murderer of her twin sister, killed one year earlier, as she becomes embroiled in a deadly duel with the anonymous killer who knows all too much about her. Reprint.
spanish_description: Una misteriosa serie de pinturas en un museo de arte de Hong Kong, incluyendo una que presenta a una mujer con un asombroso parecido, lleva a la fotoperiodista Jordan Glass a una dolorosa búsqueda del asesino de su hermana gemela, asesinada un año antes, mientras se ve envuelta en un duelo mortal con el asesino anónimo que sabe demasiado sobre ella. Reimpresión.

title: The pillars of the earth
description: A story of passion and idealism, which describes a group of men and women in the Middle Ages whosedestinies are fatefully linked with the building of a cathedral.
tagged_description: 9780451207142 A story of passion and idealism, which describes a group of men and women in the Middle Ages whosedestinies are fatefully linked with the building of a cathedral.
spanish_description: Una historia de pasión e idealismo, que describe a un grupo de hombres y mujeres en la Edad Media cuyos destinos están fatídicamente ligados a la construcción de una catedral.

title: The Love You Make
description: A close friend and business manager for the legendary group portrays the personal lives of the members of the Beatles, from their youth in Liverpool to their rise to success in the world of pop music to the death of John Lennon in 1980. Reprint.
title_and_subtitle: The Love You Make: An Insider's Story of the Beatles
tagged_description: 9780451207357 A close friend and business manager for the legendary group portrays the personal lives of the members of the Beatles, from their youth in Liverpool to their rise to success in the world of pop music to the death of John Lennon in 1980. Reprint.
spanish_description: Un amigo cercano y representante comercial del legendario grupo retrata la vida personal de los miembros de los Beatles, desde su juventud en Liverpool hasta su ascenso al éxito en el mundo de la música pop hasta la muerte de John Lennon en 1980. Reimpresión.

title: Trapped
description: When a psychopathic con man kidnaps Will and Karen Jennings's five-year-old daughter, the couple decides to fight back to save their daughter. Reissue. (A Columbia Pictures film, releasing August 2002, starring Charlize Theron, Kevin Bacon, & Courtney Love) (Suspense)
tagged_description: 9780451207500 When a psychopathic con man kidnaps Will and Karen Jennings's five-year-old daughter, the couple decides to fight back to save their daughter. Reissue. (A Columbia Pictures film, releasing August 2002, starring Charlize Theron, Kevin Bacon, & Courtney Love) (Suspense)
spanish_description: Cuando un estafador psicópata secuestra a la hija de cinco años de Will y Karen Jennings, la pareja decide luchar para salvarla. Reedición. (Una película de Columbia Pictures, estrenada en agosto de 2002, protagonizada por Charlize Theron, Kevin Bacon y Courtney Love) (Suspense)

title: Jackdaws
description: With the Allies preparing for the invasion of Nazi-occupied Europe, Felicity "Flick" Clariet, a British special operations agent, must take on the job of destroying German lines of communication with the aid of an all-woman team.
tagged_description: 9780451207524 With the Allies preparing for the invasion of Nazi-occupied Europe, Felicity "Flick" Clariet, a British special operations agent, must take on the job of destroying German lines of communication with the aid of an all-woman team.
spanish_description: Mientras los aliados se preparan para la invasión de la Europa ocupada por los nazis, Felicity "Flick" Clariet, una agente de operaciones especiales británica, debe asumir la tarea de destruir las líneas de comunicación alemanas con la ayuda de un equipo formado exclusivamente por mujeres.

title: The Oath
description: Attorney Dismas Hardy makes a discovery that threatens his family and his friendship with homicide lieutenant Abe Glitsky while representing Dr. Eric Kensing, a man accused of murdering the head of San Francisco's largest HMO.
tagged_description: 9780451207647 Attorney Dismas Hardy makes a discovery that threatens his family and his friendship with homicide lieutenant Abe Glitsky while representing Dr. Eric Kensing, a man accused of murdering the head of San Francisco's largest HMO.
spanish_description: El abogado Dismas Hardy hace un descubrimiento que amenaza a su familia y su amistad con el teniente de homicidios Abe Glitsky mientras representa al Dr. Eric Kensing, un hombre acusado de asesinar al director de la HMO más grande de San Francisco.

title: The Key to Rebecca
description: While Rommel's army bears down on Cairo, a ruthless Nazi agent called "The Sphinx" prowls the city's ancient streets to pave the way for an invasion, with no one to stand in his way but a luckless British officer and a Jewish girl, in the classic suspense novel of World War II. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451207791 While Rommel's army bears down on Cairo, a ruthless Nazi agent called "The Sphinx" prowls the city's ancient streets to pave the way for an invasion, with no one to stand in his way but a luckless British officer and a Jewish girl, in the classic suspense novel of World War II. Reprint.
spanish_description: Mientras el ejército de Rommel avanza sobre El Cairo, un despiadado agente nazi llamado "La Esfinge" recorre las antiguas calles de la ciudad para preparar el terreno para una invasión, sin nadie que se interponga en su camino salvo un desafortunado oficial británico y una joven judía, en la clásica novela de suspense de la Segunda Guerra Mundial. Reimpresión.

title: Black Like Me
description: A white writer recounts his experiences in the American South following treatments that darkened his skin and shares his thoughts on the problems of prejudice and racial injustice.
tagged_description: 9780451208644 A white writer recounts his experiences in the American South following treatments that darkened his skin and shares his thoughts on the problems of prejudice and racial injustice.
spanish_description: Un escritor blanco relata sus experiencias en el sur de Estados Unidos después de tratamientos que oscurecieron su piel y comparte sus pensamientos sobre los problemas de los prejuicios y la injusticia racial.

title: The Man from St. Petersburg
description: Just before World War I, two men--one a noble Russian emissary, the other a denizen of Europe's underground--set in motion a concatenation of world-shaking, ultimately fatal events.
tagged_description: 9780451208705 Just before World War I, two men--one a noble Russian emissary, the other a denizen of Europe's underground--set in motion a concatenation of world-shaking, ultimately fatal events.
spanish_description: Justo antes de la Primera Guerra Mundial, dos hombres –uno un noble emisario ruso, el otro un habitante de la clandestinidad europea– pusieron en marcha una serie de acontecimientos que sacudieron al mundo y que en última instancia resultaron fatales.

title: Codebreakers' Victory
description: The first ever comprehensive look at World War II codebreaking and how it changed history, veteran cryptographer Haufler's accessible account is ground-breaking work based on years of research and interviews and the mining of previously top-secret archives. In compelling detail, Haufler shows us how cryptography brought the Japanese and Germans to their knees as only one who fought on the frontlines of this 'secret war' could tell it.
title_and_subtitle: Codebreakers' Victory: How the Allied Cryptographers Won World War II
tagged_description: 9780451209795 The first ever comprehensive look at World War II codebreaking and how it changed history, veteran cryptographer Haufler's accessible account is ground-breaking work based on years of research and interviews and the mining of previously top-secret archives. In compelling detail, Haufler shows us how cryptography brought the Japanese and Germans to their knees as only one who fought on the frontlines of this 'secret war' could tell it.
spanish_description: El primer análisis exhaustivo del descifrado de códigos de la Segunda Guerra Mundial y cómo cambió la historia. El relato accesible del veterano criptógrafo Haufler es un trabajo pionero basado en años de investigación, entrevistas y la exploración de archivos previamente ultrasecretos. Con un detalle fascinante, Haufler nos muestra cómo la criptografía sometió a japoneses y alemanes, como solo alguien que luchó en el frente de esta "guerra secreta" podría contarlo.

title: No Second Chance
description: Shot twice by an unseen assailant, Dr. Marc Seidman lies in a hospital bed. His wife has been killed. His baby daughter has vanished. Then the ransom note arrives.
tagged_description: 9780451210555 Shot twice by an unseen assailant, Dr. Marc Seidman lies in a hospital bed. His wife has been killed. His baby daughter has vanished. Then the ransom note arrives.
spanish_description: Tras recibir dos disparos de un asaltante invisible, el Dr. Marc Seidman yace en una cama de hospital. Su esposa ha sido asesinada. Su pequeña hija ha desaparecido. Entonces llega la nota de rescate.

title: A Case of Need
description: When a young woman dies mysteriously on an operating table and her physician is accused of murder, a colleague's investigation takes him from a deadly sex and drug underworld to the heights of Boston society as he searches for the truth. A first novel. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780451210630 When a young woman dies mysteriously on an operating table and her physician is accused of murder, a colleague's investigation takes him from a deadly sex and drug underworld to the heights of Boston society as he searches for the truth. A first novel. Reissue.
spanish_description: Cuando una joven muere misteriosamente en una mesa de operaciones y su médico es acusado de asesinato, la investigación de un colega lo lleva del letal submundo del sexo y las drogas a las altas esferas de la sociedad bostoniana en busca de la verdad. Primera novela. Reedición.

title: The Gunslinger
description: Roland, the world's last gunslinger, tracks an enigmatic Man in Black toward a forbidding dark tower, fighting forces both mortal and other-worldly on his quest
tagged_description: 9780451210845 Roland, the world's last gunslinger, tracks an enigmatic Man in Black toward a forbidding dark tower, fighting forces both mortal and other-worldly on his quest
spanish_description: Roland, el último pistolero del mundo, sigue la pista de un enigmático Hombre de Negro hacia una imponente torre oscura, luchando contra fuerzas tanto mortales como de otro mundo en su búsqueda.

title: The Drawing of the Three
description: Roland is drawn through a gateway of time and space into the drug-and-crime-ridden world of the twentieth-century to battle a dark power determined to prevent his search for the Dark Tower.
tagged_description: 9780451210852 Roland is drawn through a gateway of time and space into the drug-and-crime-ridden world of the twentieth-century to battle a dark power determined to prevent his search for the Dark Tower.
spanish_description: Roland es atraído a través de una puerta de tiempo y espacio hacia el mundo plagado de drogas y crimen del siglo XX para luchar contra un poder oscuro decidido a evitar su búsqueda de la Torre Oscura.

title: A Whole Lotta Love
description: Four curvaceous bombshells find love and romance in a delightful collection that features Donna Hill's Over the Rainbow, in which full-figured restaurateur Jessica Morgan finds the man of her dreams when she poses for a plus-size magazine, as well as other works by Brenda Jackson, Monica Jackson, and Francis Ray. Original.
tagged_description: 9780451210906 Four curvaceous bombshells find love and romance in a delightful collection that features Donna Hill's Over the Rainbow, in which full-figured restaurateur Jessica Morgan finds the man of her dreams when she poses for a plus-size magazine, as well as other works by Brenda Jackson, Monica Jackson, and Francis Ray. Original.
spanish_description: Cuatro bellezas con curvas encuentran el amor y el romance en una encantadora colección que incluye "Over the Rainbow" de Donna Hill, donde la restauradora Jessica Morgan, de figura voluptuosa, encuentra al hombre de sus sueños al posar para una revista de tallas grandes, además de otras obras de Brenda Jackson, Monica Jackson y Francis Ray. Original.

title: Night Over Water
description: An English aristocrat, a German scientist, a murderer, a thief, and a beautiful woman are among the desperate passengers who board the most luxurious airliner ever built to escape from England just two days after the 1939 declaration of war against Germany. Reprint. 12,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780451211477 An English aristocrat, a German scientist, a murderer, a thief, and a beautiful woman are among the desperate passengers who board the most luxurious airliner ever built to escape from England just two days after the 1939 declaration of war against Germany. Reprint. 12,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Un aristócrata inglés, un científico alemán, un asesino, un ladrón y una bella mujer se encuentran entre los desesperados pasajeros que abordan el avión de pasajeros más lujoso jamás construido para escapar de Inglaterra tan solo dos días después de la declaración de guerra contra Alemania en 1939. Reimpresión. Primera tirada de 12.000 ejemplares.

title: Monkeewrench
description: Grace McBride and the team at her software company are horrified when events in their murder mystery computer game are replicated in the real world by a ruthless killer, a situation that prompts them to analyze the game in order to anticipate his next move. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451211576 Grace McBride and the team at her software company are horrified when events in their murder mystery computer game are replicated in the real world by a ruthless killer, a situation that prompts them to analyze the game in order to anticipate his next move. Reprint.
spanish_description: Grace McBride y el equipo de su empresa de software se horrorizan cuando los sucesos de su videojuego de misterio y asesinato son replicados en el mundo real por un asesino despiadado. Esta situación los lleva a analizar el juego para anticipar su próximo movimiento. Reimpresión.

title: On Wings of Eagles
description: Recreates the harrowing, real-life adventure of the successful prison break engineered by Col. Bull Simons, a World War II and Vietnam commando, who rescued two Texans imprisoned in a Teheran jail on behalf of Ross Perot. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451213099 Recreates the harrowing, real-life adventure of the successful prison break engineered by Col. Bull Simons, a World War II and Vietnam commando, who rescued two Texans imprisoned in a Teheran jail on behalf of Ross Perot. Reprint.
spanish_description: Recrea la desgarradora aventura real de la exitosa fuga de prisión orquestada por el coronel Bull Simons, un comando de la Segunda Guerra Mundial y Vietnam, quien rescató a dos tejanos presos en una cárcel de Teherán en nombre de Ross Perot. Reimpresión.

title: The Agony and the Ecstasy
description: A classic historical novel honoring the five hundredth anniversary of the artist's famed David sculpture dramatizes the life of the Renaissance artistic genius Michelangelo, recalls his love affairs, his disputes with cardinals and popes, and his years of working on the Sistine Chapel. Reprint.
title_and_subtitle: The Agony and the Ecstasy: A Biographical Novel of Michelangelo
tagged_description: 9780451213235 A classic historical novel honoring the five hundredth anniversary of the artist's famed David sculpture dramatizes the life of the Renaissance artistic genius Michelangelo, recalls his love affairs, his disputes with cardinals and popes, and his years of working on the Sistine Chapel. Reprint.
spanish_description: Una novela histórica clásica que conmemora el quincuagésimo aniversario de la famosa escultura del David del artista, narra la vida del genio artístico renacentista Miguel Ángel, rememora sus amoríos, sus disputas con cardenales y papas, y sus años de trabajo en la Capilla Sixtina. Reimpresión.

title: The Innocent
description: Years after being released from jail, Matt Hunter's hopes of moving on with his pregnant wife are shattered when he becomes the focus of a serial murder investigation.
tagged_description: 9780451215772 Years after being released from jail, Matt Hunter's hopes of moving on with his pregnant wife are shattered when he becomes the focus of a serial murder investigation.
spanish_description: Años después de salir de la cárcel, las esperanzas de Matt Hunter de seguir adelante con su esposa embarazada se hacen añicos cuando se convierte en el foco de una investigación por asesinato en serie.

title: Dispatch
description: A man with a talent for writing letters that get results, from editorials to complaints to love letters--Jason Handford is delighted when he is offered a job to write letters for a living, until he discovers that his new career has horrific implications. Original.
tagged_description: 9780451216779 A man with a talent for writing letters that get results, from editorials to complaints to love letters--Jason Handford is delighted when he is offered a job to write letters for a living, until he discovers that his new career has horrific implications. Original.
spanish_description: Jason Handford, un hombre con talento para escribir cartas que dan resultados, desde editoriales hasta quejas y cartas de amor, está encantado cuando le ofrecen un trabajo para ganarse la vida escribiendo cartas, hasta que descubre que su nueva profesión tiene consecuencias terribles. Original.

title: Dark Lover
description: When one of his most trusted fighters is killed, orphaning a half-breed daughter, Wrath, the only purebred vampire left on Earth, finds Beth Randall and ushers her into the world of the undead where she must fulfill her destiny by his side. Original.
title_and_subtitle: Dark Lover: A Novel of the Black Dagger Brotherhood
tagged_description: 9780451216953 When one of his most trusted fighters is killed, orphaning a half-breed daughter, Wrath, the only purebred vampire left on Earth, finds Beth Randall and ushers her into the world of the undead where she must fulfill her destiny by his side. Original.
spanish_description: Cuando uno de sus guerreros más fieles muere, dejando huérfana a su hija mestiza, Wrath, el único vampiro de pura raza que queda en la Tierra, encuentra a Beth Randall y la conduce al mundo de los no muertos, donde deberá cumplir su destino a su lado. Original.

title: Bitter is the New Black
description: A hilarious memoir chronicles the adventures and misadventures of a woman whose perfect life, perfect job, and perfect man vanish when she goes from a six-figures career to unemployment. Original.
title_and_subtitle: Bitter is the New Black: Confessions of a Condescending, Egomaniacal, Self-centered Smart-ass, Or, why You Should Never Carry a Prada Bag to the Unemployment Office : a Memoir
tagged_description: 9780451217608 A hilarious memoir chronicles the adventures and misadventures of a woman whose perfect life, perfect job, and perfect man vanish when she goes from a six-figures career to unemployment. Original.
spanish_description: Una divertida autobiografía que narra las aventuras y desventuras de una mujer cuya vida, trabajo y hombre perfectos se desvanecen cuando pasa de una carrera millonaria al desempleo. Original.

title: A Certain Justice
description: A novel that examines the nature of justice--and injustice--follows an ordinary man who, through no fault of his own, is hounded, hunted, and almost destroyed for a crime he did not commit.
tagged_description: 9780451217769 A novel that examines the nature of justice--and injustice--follows an ordinary man who, through no fault of his own, is hounded, hunted, and almost destroyed for a crime he did not commit.
spanish_description: Una novela que examina la naturaleza de la justicia y la injusticia; sigue a un hombre común y corriente que, sin culpa propia, es perseguido, cazado y casi destruido por un crimen que no cometió.

title: Lover Eternal
description: Fierce warrior and legendary lover, Rhage, a vampire cursed by the Scribe Virgin and owned by the dark side, finds salvation in Mary Luce, the innocent young beauty he has sworn to protect, and together they battle against their enemies and fight for eternal love. Original.
title_and_subtitle: Lover Eternal: A Novel of the Black Dagger Brotherhood
tagged_description: 9780451218049 Fierce warrior and legendary lover, Rhage, a vampire cursed by the Scribe Virgin and owned by the dark side, finds salvation in Mary Luce, the innocent young beauty he has sworn to protect, and together they battle against their enemies and fight for eternal love. Original.
spanish_description: Rhage, un feroz guerrero y amante legendario, un vampiro maldecido por la Virgen Escriba y dominado por el lado oscuro, encuentra la salvación en Mary Luce, la joven e inocente belleza a quien juró proteger. Juntos luchan contra sus enemigos y por el amor eterno. Original.

title: Promise Me
description: Entertainment agent Myron Bolitar offers a ride home to a young girl to prevent her from accepting a ride from a drunk driver, but when the girl disappears, he is forced to rescue her to prove his innocence.
tagged_description: 9780451219244 Entertainment agent Myron Bolitar offers a ride home to a young girl to prevent her from accepting a ride from a drunk driver, but when the girl disappears, he is forced to rescue her to prove his innocence.
spanish_description: El agente de entretenimiento Myron Bolitar ofrece llevar a una joven a su casa para evitar que acepte que la lleve un conductor ebrio, pero cuando la niña desaparece, se ve obligado a rescatarla para demostrar su inocencia.

title: Lover Awakened
description: When Zsadist, the most feared member of the Black Dagger Brotherhood, rescues Bella from the evil Lessening Society, he is nearly driven insane by rage against her tormentors, and must confront his tortured past in order to have a future with this brave beauty who is his destiny. Original.
title_and_subtitle: Lover Awakened: A Novel of the Black Dagger Brotherhood
tagged_description: 9780451219367 When Zsadist, the most feared member of the Black Dagger Brotherhood, rescues Bella from the evil Lessening Society, he is nearly driven insane by rage against her tormentors, and must confront his tortured past in order to have a future with this brave beauty who is his destiny. Original.
spanish_description: Cuando Zsadist, el miembro más temido de la Hermandad de la Daga Negra, rescata a Bella de la malvada Sociedad Lessening, la ira contra sus torturadores lo lleva casi a la locura y debe confrontar su tormentoso pasado para tener un futuro con esta valiente belleza que es su destino. Original.

title: Belle Ruin
description: Discovering the crumbling remains of a once-fabulous hotel in the woods near her small home town, twelve-year-old cub reporter Emma Graham stumbles upon clues pertaining to a forty-year-old unsolved crime involving deeply buried family secrets. By the author of The Winds of Change. Reprint. 100,000 first printing.
tagged_description: 9780451219442 Discovering the crumbling remains of a once-fabulous hotel in the woods near her small home town, twelve-year-old cub reporter Emma Graham stumbles upon clues pertaining to a forty-year-old unsolved crime involving deeply buried family secrets. By the author of The Winds of Change. Reprint. 100,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Al descubrir los restos desmoronados de un hotel antaño fabuloso en el bosque cercano a su pequeño pueblo natal, Emma Graham, una joven reportera de doce años, encuentra pistas sobre un crimen sin resolver de hace cuarenta años que involucra secretos familiares profundamente enterrados. Por la autora de Vientos de Cambio. Reimpresión. Primera edición con 100.000 ejemplares.

title: What Angels Fear
description: The prime suspect in the brutal rape and murder of a young woman whose body is left in an ancient church, young aristocrat Sebastian St. Cyr becomes a fugitive and flees a ruthless powerbroker with ties to the Prince Regent. Reprint.
title_and_subtitle: What Angels Fear: A Sebastian St. Cyr Mystery
tagged_description: 9780451219718 The prime suspect in the brutal rape and murder of a young woman whose body is left in an ancient church, young aristocrat Sebastian St. Cyr becomes a fugitive and flees a ruthless powerbroker with ties to the Prince Regent. Reprint.
spanish_description: El principal sospechoso de la brutal violación y asesinato de una joven cuyo cuerpo fue abandonado en una antigua iglesia, el joven aristócrata Sebastian St. Cyr, se convierte en fugitivo y huye de un despiadado agente de poder vinculado al Príncipe Regente. Reimpresión.

title: The Last Templar
description: When the opening gala of a Vatican exhibit attended by archaeologist Tess Chaykin is stormed by four horsemen dressed as Templar Knights who steal an artifact, FBI anti-terrorist specialist Sean Reilly and Tess team up for an investigation. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451219954 When the opening gala of a Vatican exhibit attended by archaeologist Tess Chaykin is stormed by four horsemen dressed as Templar Knights who steal an artifact, FBI anti-terrorist specialist Sean Reilly and Tess team up for an investigation. Reprint.
spanish_description: Cuando la gala inaugural de una exposición del Vaticano, a la que asiste la arqueóloga Tess Chaykin, es asaltada por cuatro jinetes vestidos de Templarios que roban un artefacto, el especialista antiterrorista del FBI, Sean Reilly, y Tess se unen para una investigación. Reimpresión.

title: Bright Lights, Big Ass
description: A hilarious new memoir by the best-selling author of Bitter Is the New Black chronicles the not-so-wonderful moments of her life in the big city, from reporting rude neighbors to Homeland Security or harboring a crush on her grocery store clerk, to fighting and losing the Battle of the Stairmaster. Original.
title_and_subtitle: Bright Lights, Big Ass: A Self-indulgent, Surly Ex-sorority Girl's Guide to why it Often Sucks in the City, Or, Who are These Idiots and why Do They All Live Next Door to Me?
tagged_description: 9780451221254 A hilarious new memoir by the best-selling author of Bitter Is the New Black chronicles the not-so-wonderful moments of her life in the big city, from reporting rude neighbors to Homeland Security or harboring a crush on her grocery store clerk, to fighting and losing the Battle of the Stairmaster. Original.
spanish_description: Unas nuevas y divertidas memorias de la autora del éxito de ventas "Bitter Is the New Black" narran los momentos menos agradables de su vida en la gran ciudad, desde denunciar a vecinos groseros a Seguridad Nacional o sentir un flechazo por el dependiente de su supermercado, hasta luchar y perder la Batalla de la Escalera Móvil. Original.

title: Angel Christmas
authors: Topaz;Mary Balogh;Emma Merritt;Marilyn Campbell;Patricia Rice;Carole Nelson Douglas
description: Five yuletide romances about divine intervention include Mary Balogh's "Guarded by Angels," Marilyn Campbell's "The Trouble With Angelina," Carole Nelson Douglas's "Catch a Falling Angel," Emma Merritt's "Brush of Angel Wings," and Patricia Rice's "Tin Angel." Original.
tagged_description: 9780451406286 Five yuletide romances about divine intervention include Mary Balogh's "Guarded by Angels," Marilyn Campbell's "The Trouble With Angelina," Carole Nelson Douglas's "Catch a Falling Angel," Emma Merritt's "Brush of Angel Wings," and Patricia Rice's "Tin Angel." Original.
spanish_description: Cinco romances navideños sobre la intervención divina incluyen "Guarded by Angels" de Mary Balogh, "The Trouble With Angelina" de Marilyn Campbell, "Catch a Falling Angel" de Carole Nelson Douglas, "Brush of Angel Wings" de Emma Merritt y "Tin Angel" de Patricia Rice. Original.

title: Shadow Lover
description: Taking care of her dying Aunt Sally, the only mother she has ever known, Carolyn Smith is stunned when Sally's son Alex returns after eighteen years, especially since she witnessed his murder on the night of his supposed disappearance, and as she races against time to expose the sensual imposter, she enters a world of dark secrets, passion, and deceit. Original.
tagged_description: 9780451408693 Taking care of her dying Aunt Sally, the only mother she has ever known, Carolyn Smith is stunned when Sally's son Alex returns after eighteen years, especially since she witnessed his murder on the night of his supposed disappearance, and as she races against time to expose the sensual imposter, she enters a world of dark secrets, passion, and deceit. Original.
spanish_description: Mientras cuida de su tía Sally, la única madre que ha conocido, Carolyn Smith se queda atónita cuando su hijo, Alex, regresa después de dieciocho años, sobre todo porque presenció su asesinato la noche de su supuesta desaparición. En una carrera contrarreloj para desenmascarar al sensual impostor, se adentra en un mundo de oscuros secretos, pasión y engaños. Original.

title: The Medusa Stone
description: Ten years ago, the American spy satellite Medusa malfunctioned and crashed--but not before its sensors revealed a secret buried deep in the Earth, hidden for thousands of years from the eyes of man. It's a priceless discovery that some will die to find--and kill to possess.
tagged_description: 9780451409225 Ten years ago, the American spy satellite Medusa malfunctioned and crashed--but not before its sensors revealed a secret buried deep in the Earth, hidden for thousands of years from the eyes of man. It's a priceless discovery that some will die to find--and kill to possess.
spanish_description: Hace diez años, el satélite espía estadounidense Medusa falló y se estrelló, pero no antes de que sus sensores revelaran un secreto enterrado en las profundidades de la Tierra, oculto durante miles de años a la vista del hombre. Es un descubrimiento invaluable que algunos morirían por encontrarlo y matarían por poseerlo.

title: Pandora's Curse
description: A deadly fifty-year-old secret from World War II, hidden away at a top-secret Nazi submarine base, could spell disaster for the modern world when a ruthless corporate mercenary plans to hold the entire world hostage, unless geologist Philip Mercer and his colleague, Anika Klein, can stop him. Original.
tagged_description: 9780451409638 A deadly fifty-year-old secret from World War II, hidden away at a top-secret Nazi submarine base, could spell disaster for the modern world when a ruthless corporate mercenary plans to hold the entire world hostage, unless geologist Philip Mercer and his colleague, Anika Klein, can stop him. Original.
spanish_description: Un secreto mortal de cincuenta años de la Segunda Guerra Mundial, oculto en una base submarina nazi de alto secreto, podría ser un desastre para el mundo moderno cuando un despiadado mercenario corporativo planea secuestrar al mundo entero, a menos que el geólogo Philip Mercer y su colega, Anika Klein, puedan detenerlo. Original.

title: River of Ruin
description: Bidding on a rare diary, written during the French attempt to dig the Panama Canal, geologist Philip Mercer finds himself caught up in a complex Chinese plot to trigger a shift in the world's balance of power.
tagged_description: 9780451410542 Bidding on a rare diary, written during the French attempt to dig the Panama Canal, geologist Philip Mercer finds himself caught up in a complex Chinese plot to trigger a shift in the world's balance of power.
spanish_description: Al pujar por un diario raro, escrito durante el intento francés de excavar el Canal de Panamá, el geólogo Philip Mercer se ve atrapado en un complejo complot chino para provocar un cambio en el equilibrio de poder mundial.

title: Deep Fire Rising
description: Dr. Philip Mercer, a wealthy geologist charged with overseeing the installation of a temporary nuclear waste holding tank at Nevada's infamous Area 51, discovers a secret group called the Order and their plans for world domination.
tagged_description: 9780451411181 Dr. Philip Mercer, a wealthy geologist charged with overseeing the installation of a temporary nuclear waste holding tank at Nevada's infamous Area 51, discovers a secret group called the Order and their plans for world domination.
spanish_description: El Dr. Philip Mercer, un rico geólogo encargado de supervisar la instalación de un tanque temporal de almacenamiento de desechos nucleares en el infame Área 51 de Nevada, descubre un grupo secreto llamado la Orden y sus planes de dominación mundial.

title: Jerusalem Inn
description: Superintendent Richard Jury of Scotland Yard spends his Christmas holiday at a colorful country inn near a vast estate inhabited by the titled, the rich, the famous, and, suddenly, the deceased. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451411617 Superintendent Richard Jury of Scotland Yard spends his Christmas holiday at a colorful country inn near a vast estate inhabited by the titled, the rich, the famous, and, suddenly, the deceased. Reprint.
spanish_description: El superintendente Richard Jury de Scotland Yard pasa sus vacaciones de Navidad en una pintoresca posada rural cerca de una vasta finca habitada por nobles, ricos, famosos y, de repente, difuntos. Reimpresión.

title: Vulcan's Forge
description: The dramatic eruption of a volcano in the Pacific Ocean results in a world-wide battle for domination when it becomes obvious that Vulcan's Forge can provide a limitless supply of clean nuclear energy.
tagged_description: 9780451412102 The dramatic eruption of a volcano in the Pacific Ocean results in a world-wide battle for domination when it becomes obvious that Vulcan's Forge can provide a limitless supply of clean nuclear energy.
spanish_description: La dramática erupción de un volcán en el Océano Pacífico da lugar a una batalla mundial por la dominación cuando se hace evidente que la Forja de Vulcano puede proporcionar un suministro ilimitado de energía nuclear limpia.

title: Charon's Landing
description: Paid millions of dollars by a rogue Arab oil minister to sabotage the Alaska pipeline, Russian mastermind Ivan Kerikov accidentally crosses paths with geologist Philip Mercer, who begins to unravel a tangled web of ecological and economic terrorism. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451412119 Paid millions of dollars by a rogue Arab oil minister to sabotage the Alaska pipeline, Russian mastermind Ivan Kerikov accidentally crosses paths with geologist Philip Mercer, who begins to unravel a tangled web of ecological and economic terrorism. Reprint.
spanish_description: Pagado con millones de dólares por un ministro de petróleo árabe rebelde para sabotear el oleoducto de Alaska, el cerebro ruso Ivan Kerikov se cruza accidentalmente con el geólogo Philip Mercer, quien comienza a desentrañar una enmarañada red de terrorismo ecológico y económico. Reimpresión.

title: Lover Revealed
description: The only human allowed in the inner circle of the Black Dagger Brotherhood, ex-homicide cop Butch O'Neal, after saving a civilian vampire from the dreaded slayers, is left for dead and only the aristocratic vampire beauty he desires can bring him back. Original.
title_and_subtitle: Lover Revealed: A Novel of the Black Dagger Brotherhood
tagged_description: 9780451412355 The only human allowed in the inner circle of the Black Dagger Brotherhood, ex-homicide cop Butch O'Neal, after saving a civilian vampire from the dreaded slayers, is left for dead and only the aristocratic vampire beauty he desires can bring him back. Original.
spanish_description: El único humano admitido en el círculo íntimo de la Hermandad de la Daga Negra, el ex policía de homicidios Butch O'Neal, tras salvar a un vampiro civil de las temibles cazadoras, es dado por muerto y solo la belleza vampírica aristocrática que desea puede traerlo de vuelta. Original.

title: Robot Visions
description: Spanning Asimov's fifty-year career, this collection of eighteen stories and essays offers a visionary study of humanity's future relationship with robots, including both classic and original pieces, all based on Asimov's three laws of robotics. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780451450647 Spanning Asimov's fifty-year career, this collection of eighteen stories and essays offers a visionary study of humanity's future relationship with robots, including both classic and original pieces, all based on Asimov's three laws of robotics. Reissue.
spanish_description: Esta colección de dieciocho relatos y ensayos, que abarca los cincuenta años de carrera de Asimov, ofrece un estudio visionario de la futura relación de la humanidad con los robots. Incluye obras tanto clásicas como originales, todas basadas en las tres leyes de la robótica de Asimov. Reedición.

title: Dealing in Futures
description: This collection contains eleven of the author's finest stories, ranging from faraway planets beyond human comprehension to a nightmare future Earth. By the author of The Forever War. Original.
tagged_description: 9780451452580 This collection contains eleven of the author's finest stories, ranging from faraway planets beyond human comprehension to a nightmare future Earth. By the author of The Forever War. Original.
spanish_description: Esta colección contiene once de las mejores historias del autor, que abarcan desde planetas lejanos más allá de la comprensión humana hasta una Tierra con un futuro de pesadilla. Del autor de La Guerra Eterna. Original.

title: The Innkeeper's Song
description: As Tikat searches for the lover whose death and resurrection he witnessed, he meets three women--each of whom hides a secret, and who respectively each undertake her own impossible mission. By the author of The Last Unicorn.
tagged_description: 9780451452887 As Tikat searches for the lover whose death and resurrection he witnessed, he meets three women--each of whom hides a secret, and who respectively each undertake her own impossible mission. By the author of The Last Unicorn.
spanish_description: Mientras Tikat busca a la amante cuya muerte y resurrección presenció, conoce a tres mujeres, cada una con un secreto oculto y cada una con su propia misión imposible. Del autor de El Último Unicornio.

title: The Forest House
description: In a tale set in Druidic England, Eilan feels torn between her love for a young Roman soldier and her inner need to become a priestess for her Goddess
tagged_description: 9780451454249 In a tale set in Druidic England, Eilan feels torn between her love for a young Roman soldier and her inner need to become a priestess for her Goddess
spanish_description: En un cuento ambientado en la Inglaterra druídica, Eilan se siente dividida entre su amor por un joven soldado romano y su necesidad interior de convertirse en sacerdotisa de su Diosa.

title: Not of Woman Born
description: A collection of stories that detail modern science's effect on humankind's notions of conception, birth, and parenting includes contributions from Michael Armstrong, Robert Silverberg, Susan Palwick, and others
tagged_description: 9780451456816 A collection of stories that detail modern science's effect on humankind's notions of conception, birth, and parenting includes contributions from Michael Armstrong, Robert Silverberg, Susan Palwick, and others
spanish_description: Una colección de historias que detallan el efecto de la ciencia moderna en las nociones de la humanidad sobre la concepción, el nacimiento y la crianza de los hijos incluye contribuciones de Michael Armstrong, Robert Silverberg, Susan Palwick y otros.

title: The River's Gift
description: Fifteen-year-old Ariella spends her days in the forest caring for the animals, but when her father dies and she is threatened with marriage to a cousin she has never seen, a remarkable horselike creature from the woods will reward the girl's compassion with a special gift.
tagged_description: 9780451457592 Fifteen-year-old Ariella spends her days in the forest caring for the animals, but when her father dies and she is threatened with marriage to a cousin she has never seen, a remarkable horselike creature from the woods will reward the girl's compassion with a special gift.
spanish_description: Ariella, de quince años, pasa sus días en el bosque cuidando a los animales, pero cuando su padre muere y se ve amenazada con casarse con un primo al que nunca ha visto, una notable criatura parecida a un caballo del bosque recompensará la compasión de la niña con un regalo especial.

title: Thin Air
description: After Weather Warden Joanne Baldwin prevents Mother Earth from destroying the planet, she struggles to recover her identity after losing her memories at the hands of a vengeful jinn.
tagged_description: 9780451461636 After Weather Warden Joanne Baldwin prevents Mother Earth from destroying the planet, she struggles to recover her identity after losing her memories at the hands of a vengeful jinn.
spanish_description: Después de que la guardiana meteorológica Joanne Baldwin evita que la Madre Tierra destruya el planeta, lucha por recuperar su identidad después de perder sus recuerdos a manos de un genio vengativo.

title: Beowulf
description: The oldest extant poem in a modern European language chronicles a feudal newly Christianized world still populated by the monsters and demons of the ancient world. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451527400 The oldest extant poem in a modern European language chronicles a feudal newly Christianized world still populated by the monsters and demons of the ancient world. Reprint.
spanish_description: El poema más antiguo que se conserva en una lengua europea moderna narra un mundo feudal recién cristianizado, aún poblado por los monstruos y demonios del mundo antiguo. Reimpresión.

title: Great Dialogues of Plato
description: A new translation of the complete texts of the Republic, Apology, Crito Phaido, Ion, Meno, and Symposium reveals the genius of Plato as he struggled with education, justice, the "philosopher king," and utopian visions of society. Reprint. BAKER & TAYLOR Bks
tagged_description: 9780451527455 A new translation of the complete texts of the Republic, Apology, Crito Phaido, Ion, Meno, and Symposium reveals the genius of Plato as he struggled with education, justice, the "philosopher king," and utopian visions of society. Reprint. BAKER & TAYLOR Bks
spanish_description: Una nueva traducción de los textos completos de la República, la Apología, Critón Fedón, Ión, Menón y el Banquete revela el genio de Platón en su lucha por la educación, la justicia, el "rey filósofo" y las visiones utópicas de la sociedad. Reimpresión. Libros de Baker & Taylor.

title: The Hunchback of Notre-Dame
description: In the famed novel set against the backdrop of medieval Paris, Quasimodo, the hunchbacked bellringer of Notre-Dame Cathedral, struggles to save the beautiful gypsy dancer Esmeralda from being unjustly executed. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780451527882 In the famed novel set against the backdrop of medieval Paris, Quasimodo, the hunchbacked bellringer of Notre-Dame Cathedral, struggles to save the beautiful gypsy dancer Esmeralda from being unjustly executed. Reissue.
spanish_description: En la famosa novela ambientada en el París medieval, Quasimodo, el jorobado campanero de la catedral de Notre Dame, lucha por salvar a la bella bailarina gitana Esmeralda de una ejecución injusta. Reedición.

title: Paradise Lost and Paradise Regained
description: Presents the complete texts of the seventeenth-century English poet's two great epic poems about creation, fall, and redemption of humankind and the moral and spiritual dilemmas of God's judgment. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451527929 Presents the complete texts of the seventeenth-century English poet's two great epic poems about creation, fall, and redemption of humankind and the moral and spiritual dilemmas of God's judgment. Reprint.
spanish_description: Presenta los textos completos de los dos grandes poemas épicos del poeta inglés del siglo XVII sobre la creación, la caída y la redención de la humanidad, así como sobre los dilemas morales y espirituales del juicio divino. Reimpresión.

title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
description: Sir Charles Baskerville's sudden heart attack and death have the townspeople in shock and searching for the one to blame--the family dog--while Sherlock Holmes leads the investigation.
tagged_description: 9780451528018 Sir Charles Baskerville's sudden heart attack and death have the townspeople in shock and searching for the one to blame--the family dog--while Sherlock Holmes leads the investigation.
spanish_description: El repentino ataque cardíaco y la muerte de Sir Charles Baskerville dejan a los habitantes del pueblo en shock y buscando al culpable (el perro de la familia) mientras Sherlock Holmes lidera la investigación.

title: Madame Bovary
description: An ordinary woman's unfulfilled dreams of romantic love lead her to a series of desperate acts, including adultery, in a classic novel set against the backdrop of nineteenth-century bourgeois France. Reissue.
tagged_description: 9780451528209 An ordinary woman's unfulfilled dreams of romantic love lead her to a series of desperate acts, including adultery, in a classic novel set against the backdrop of nineteenth-century bourgeois France. Reissue.
spanish_description: Los sueños incumplidos de amor romántico de una mujer común la llevan a una serie de actos desesperados, incluido el adulterio, en una novela clásica ambientada en la Francia burguesa del siglo XIX. Reedición.

title: Ten Great Works of Philosophy
description: From ancient Greece to 19th-century America, this collection traces the history of civilization through the seminal works of its most influential thinkers including Plato, Aristotle, St. Thomas Aquinas, John Stuart Mill, and others.
tagged_description: 9780451528308 From ancient Greece to 19th-century America, this collection traces the history of civilization through the seminal works of its most influential thinkers including Plato, Aristotle, St. Thomas Aquinas, John Stuart Mill, and others.
spanish_description: Desde la antigua Grecia hasta los Estados Unidos del siglo XIX, esta colección rastrea la historia de la civilización a través de las obras seminales de sus pensadores más influyentes, incluidos Platón, Aristóteles, Santo Tomás de Aquino, John Stuart Mill y otros.

title: The Invisible Man
description: A scientist who has discovered a way to make himself invisible unleashes his growing madness and frustrations by terrorizing a small town, in a new edition of the science fiction classic. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451528520 A scientist who has discovered a way to make himself invisible unleashes his growing madness and frustrations by terrorizing a small town, in a new edition of the science fiction classic. Reprint.
spanish_description: Un científico que ha descubierto una forma de hacerse invisible desata su creciente locura y frustraciones aterrorizando a un pequeño pueblo, en una nueva edición del clásico de ciencia ficción. Reimpresión.

title: The Time Machine
description: A classic novel of the future follows the Time Traveller as he hurtles one million years into the future and encounters a world populated by two distinct races, the childlike Eloi and the disgusting Morlocks who prey on the Eloi. Reprint.
tagged_description: 9780451528551 A classic novel of the future follows the Time Traveller as he hurtles one million years into the future and encounters a world populated by two distinct races, the childlike Eloi and the disgusting Morlocks who prey on the Eloi. Reprint.
spanish_description: Una novela clásica del futuro sigue al Viajero del Tiempo mientras se precipita un millón de años hacia el futuro y se encuentra con un mundo habitado por dos razas distintas: los infantiles Eloi y los repugnantes Morlocks, que los acosan. Reimpresión.

title: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer, And, Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
description: A new edition of two popular American novels presents Twain's classic works depicting the youthful escapades of two boys living along the Mississippi, accompanied by an updated bibliography and a new introduction. Reprint.
title_and_subtitle: The Adventures of Tom Sawyer, And, Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
tagged_description: 9780451528643 A new edition of two popular American novels presents Twain's classic works depicting the youthful escapades of two boys living along the Mississippi, accompanied by an updated bibliography and a new introduction. Reprint.
spanish_description: Una nueva edición de dos populares novelas estadounidenses presenta las obras clásicas de Twain, que retratan las aventuras juveniles de dos jóvenes que viven a orillas del Misisipi, acompañadas de una bibliografía actualizada y una nueva introducción. Reimpresión.

title: Anne of Green Gables
description: Everyone's favorite redhead, the spunky Anne Shirley, begins her adventures at Green Gables, a farm outside Avonlea, Prince Edward Island. When the freckled girl realizes that the elderly Cuthberts wanted to adopt a boy instead, she begins to try to win them?and, consequently, the reader?over.
tagged_description: 9780451528827 Everyone's favorite redhead, the spunky Anne Shirley, begins her adventures at Green Gables, a farm outside Avonlea, Prince Edward Island. When the freckled girl realizes that the elderly Cuthberts wanted to adopt a boy instead, she begins to try to win them?and, consequently, the reader?over.
spanish_description: La pelirroja favorita de todos, la valiente Anne Shirley, comienza sus aventuras en Tejas Verdes, una granja a las afueras de Avonlea, Isla del Príncipe Eduardo. Cuando la pecosa se da cuenta de que los ancianos Cuthbert querían adoptar un niño, intenta conquistarlos y, en consecuencia, al lector.

title: The Travels of Marco Polo
description: Chronicling the 13th-century world from Venice, his birthplace, to the far reaches of Asia, Marco Polo tells of the foreign peoples he meets as he travels by foot, horse, and boat through places including Persia, Tibet, India, and, finally, China. This edition includes a new Introduction and a new Foreword. Original.
tagged_description: 9780451529510 Chronicling the 13th-century world from Venice, his birthplace, to the far reaches of Asia, Marco Polo tells of the foreign peoples he meets as he travels by foot, horse, and boat through places including Persia, Tibet, India, and, finally, China. This edition includes a new Introduction and a new Foreword. Original.
spanish_description: Al narrar el mundo del siglo XIII, desde Venecia, su ciudad natal, hasta los confines de Asia, Marco Polo relata los pueblos extranjeros que conoció en sus viajes a pie, a caballo y en barco por lugares como Persia, el Tíbet, la India y, finalmente, China. Esta edición incluye una nueva introducción y un nuevo prólogo. Original.

title: David Copperfield
description: David Copperfield suffers from his abusive stepfather and the betrayal of the scheming Uriah Heep, finds a new life with his formidable aunt, and falls in love with Dora, as he fights to escape his impoverished and unhappy childhood.
tagged_description: 9780451530042 David Copperfield suffers from his abusive stepfather and the betrayal of the scheming Uriah Heep, finds a new life with his formidable aunt, and falls in love with Dora, as he fights to escape his impoverished and unhappy childhood.
spanish_description: David Copperfield sufre por su padrastro abusivo y la traición del intrigante Uriah Heep, encuentra una nueva vida con su formidable tía y se enamora de Dora, mientras lucha por escapar de su infancia empobrecida e infeliz.

title: Pygmalion
description: Accompanied by the adaptation and lyrics of the Broadway play "My Fair Lady," this play follows Professor Henry Higgins as he transforms a rough-hewn girl into a sophisticated lady of society.
title_and_subtitle: Pygmalion: A Romance in Five Acts
tagged_description: 9780451530097 Accompanied by the adaptation and lyrics of the Broadway play "My Fair Lady," this play follows Professor Henry Higgins as he transforms a rough-hewn girl into a sophisticated lady of society.
spanish_description: Acompañada por la adaptación y la letra de la obra de Broadway "My Fair Lady", esta obra sigue al profesor Henry Higgins mientras transforma a una niña tosca en una sofisticada dama de la sociedad.

title: A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man
description: Follows rebellious artist Stephen Dedalus from his days as a young student to the deep religious conflict he experiences at a day school in Dublin, to his college years, during which he challenges the conventions of his upbringing.
title_and_subtitle: A Portrait of the Artist as a Young Man
tagged_description: 9780451530158 Follows rebellious artist Stephen Dedalus from his days as a young student to the deep religious conflict he experiences at a day school in Dublin, to his college years, during which he challenges the conventions of his upbringing.
spanish_description: Sigue al artista rebelde Stephen Dedalus desde sus días como joven estudiante hasta el profundo conflicto religioso que experimenta en una escuela diurna en Dublín, hasta sus años universitarios, durante los cuales desafía las convenciones de su educación.

title: Chekhov, the Major Plays
description: This volume includes the classic plays Ivanov (1889), The Sea Gull (1896), Uncle Vanya (1902), Three Sisters (1901), and The Cherry Orchard (1904); each a masterwork of naturalistic drama.
tagged_description: 9780451530370 This volume includes the classic plays Ivanov (1889), The Sea Gull (1896), Uncle Vanya (1902), Three Sisters (1901), and The Cherry Orchard (1904); each a masterwork of naturalistic drama.
spanish_description: Este volumen incluye las obras clásicas Ivanov (1889), La gaviota (1896), El tío Vania (1902), Las tres hermanas (1901) y El jardín de los cerezos (1904); cada una de ellas una obra maestra del drama naturalista.

title: The Autobiography of Andrew Carnegie and the Gospel of Wealth
description: Discusses the life and work of Andrew Carnegie, describing how he left Scotland at age thirteen, began a menial job at a bobbin factory, and eventually amassed a fortune, most of which he gave to charitable causes.
title_and_subtitle: The Autobiography of Andrew Carnegie and the Gospel of Wealth
tagged_description: 9780451530387 Discusses the life and work of Andrew Carnegie, describing how he left Scotland at age thirteen, began a menial job at a bobbin factory, and eventually amassed a fortune, most of which he gave to charitable causes.
spanish_description: Analiza la vida y la obra de Andrew Carnegie, describiendo cómo abandonó Escocia a los trece años, empezó un trabajo doméstico en una fábrica de bobinas y acabó amasando una fortuna, la mayor parte de la cual donó a causas benéficas.

title: Sleeping Beauty Novels
description: Celebrate the daring gifts of Anne Rice, writing as A. N. Roquelaure, with this beautifully repackaged boxed set of the three erotic novels in her acclaimed Sleeping Beauty trilogy.
tagged_description: 9780452156616 Celebrate the daring gifts of Anne Rice, writing as A. N. Roquelaure, with this beautifully repackaged boxed set of the three erotic novels in her acclaimed Sleeping Beauty trilogy.
spanish_description: Celebre los atrevidos dones de Anne Rice, que escribe como A. N. Roquelaure, con este hermoso paquete reeditado de las tres novelas eróticas de su aclamada trilogía La Bella Durmiente.

title: Stephen King's Creepshow
description: Stories in comic strip form tell of a murdered man returning from the grave, a bizarre meteor, a monster that devours people, a husband's terrible revenge, and a plague of cockroaches
title_and_subtitle: Stephen King's Creepshow: A George A. Romero Film
tagged_description: 9780452253803 Stories in comic strip form tell of a murdered man returning from the grave, a bizarre meteor, a monster that devours people, a husband's terrible revenge, and a plague of cockroaches
spanish_description: Las historias en forma de tira cómica cuentan la historia de un hombre asesinado que regresa de la tumba, un meteorito extraño, un monstruo que devora a la gente, la terrible venganza de un marido y una plaga de cucarachas.

title: Song of Solomon
description: This novel takes readers into a magical and richly peopled world which encompasses four generations of African American life. Copyright © Libri GmbH. All rights reserved.
tagged_description: 9780452260115 This novel takes readers into a magical and richly peopled world which encompasses four generations of African American life. Copyright © Libri GmbH. All rights reserved.
spanish_description: Esta novela transporta al lector a un mundo mágico y rico en gente que abarca cuatro generaciones de la vida afroamericana. Copyright © Libri GmbH. Reservados todos los derechos.

title: Because it is Bitter, and Because it is My Heart
description: A white woman and a black woman in upstate New York during the 1950s are strangely and fatefully linked when one witnesses a murderous street fight in which the other is involved
title_and_subtitle: Because it is Bitter, and Because it is My Heart
tagged_description: 9780452265813 A white woman and a black woman in upstate New York during the 1950s are strangely and fatefully linked when one witnesses a murderous street fight in which the other is involved
spanish_description: Una mujer blanca y una mujer negra en el norte del estado de Nueva York durante la década de 1950 se vinculan de manera extraña y fatídica cuando una presencia una pelea callejera asesina en la que está involucrada la otra.

title: When Food is Love
description: An examination of the link between eating disorders and the need for intimacy explains how eating disorders sabotage intimate relationships and why many people overeat to satisfy their emotional hunger. Reprint. 50,000 first printing.
title_and_subtitle: When Food is Love: Exploring the Relationship Between Eating and Intimacy
tagged_description: 9780452268180 An examination of the link between eating disorders and the need for intimacy explains how eating disorders sabotage intimate relationships and why many people overeat to satisfy their emotional hunger. Reprint. 50,000 first printing.
spanish_description: Un análisis del vínculo entre los trastornos alimentarios y la necesidad de intimidad explica cómo estos trastornos sabotean las relaciones íntimas y por qué muchas personas comen en exceso para satisfacer su hambre emocional. Reimpresión. Primera edición con 50.000 ejemplares.

title: For Keeps
description: A collection of film reviews, most of them originally published in the "New Yorker," selected from the author's previous collections, covers movies from "Hud" to "Dances with Wolves"
tagged_description: 9780452273085 A collection of film reviews, most of them originally published in the "New Yorker," selected from the author's previous collections, covers movies from "Hud" to "Dances with Wolves"
spanish_description: Una colección de críticas de películas, la mayoría de ellas publicadas originalmente en "The New Yorker", seleccionadas de las colecciones anteriores del autor, que abarcan películas desde "Hud" hasta "Dances with Wolves".

title: In the Time of the Butterflies
description: The life and death of three revolutionary sisters in the Dominican Republic, told by a surviving fourth. One by one the Mirabal Sisters, as they were known, join the opposition to the Trujillo dictatorship in the 1950s, suffering imprisonment and torture while their men watch powerless. They are released, then one night their jeep is ambushed. A story based on real events by the author of How the Garcia Girls Lost Their Accents.
title_and_subtitle: In the Time of the Butterflies
tagged_description: 9780452274426 The life and death of three revolutionary sisters in the Dominican Republic, told by a surviving fourth. One by one the Mirabal Sisters, as they were known, join the opposition to the Trujillo dictatorship in the 1950s, suffering imprisonment and torture while their men watch powerless. They are released, then one night their jeep is ambushed. A story based on real events by the author of How the Garcia Girls Lost Their Accents.
spanish_description: La vida y la muerte de tres hermanas revolucionarias en la República Dominicana, narrada por una cuarta sobreviviente. Una a una, las Hermanas Mirabal, como se las conocía, se unen a la oposición a la dictadura de Trujillo en la década de 1950, sufriendo prisión y tortura mientras sus hombres observan impotentes. Son liberadas, pero una noche su jeep sufre una emboscada. Una historia basada en hechos reales, del autor de "Cómo las chicas García perdieron el acento".

title: Zombie

title: The Clock Of The Long Now
description: Using the designing and building of the Clock of the Long Now as a framework, this is a book about the practical use of long time perspective: how to get it, how to use it, how to keep it in and out of sight. Here are the central questions it inspires: How do we make long-term thinking automatic and common instead of difficult and rare? Discipline in thought allows freedom. One needs the space and reliability to predict continuity to have the confidence not to be afraid of revolutions Taking the time to think of the future is more essential now than ever, as culture accelerates beyond its ability to be measured Probable things are vastly outnumbered by countless near-impossible eventualities. Reality is statistically forced to be extraordinary; fiction is not allowed this freedom This is a potent book that combines the chronicling of fantastic technology with equally visionary philosophical inquiry.

title: The Culture of Fear
description: There has never been another era in modern history, even during wartime or the Great Depression, when so many people have feared so much. Three out of four Americans say they feel more fearful today then they did twenty years ago. The Culture of Fear describes the high costs of living in a fear-ridden environment where realism has become rarer than doors without deadbolts.Why do we have so many fears these days? Are we living in exceptionally dangerous times? To watch the news, you'd certainly think so, but Glassner demonstrates that it is our perception of danger that has increased, not the actual level of risk. The Culture of Fear is an expose of the people and organizations that manipulate our perceptions and profit from our fears: politicians who win elections by heightening concerns about crime and drug use even as rates for both are declining; advocacy groups that raise money by exaggerating the prevalence of particular diseases; TV newsmagazines that monger a new scare every week to garner ratings.Glassner spells out the prices we pay for social panics: the huge sums of money that go to waste on unnecessary programs and products as well as time and energy spent worrying about our fears.

Glassner explica los precios que pagamos por los pánicos sociales: las enormes sumas de dinero que se desperdician en programas y productos innecesarios, así como el tiempo y la energía gastados en preocuparnos por nuestros miedos.

title: The Drama of the Gifted Child
description: Why are many of the most successful people plagued by feelings of emptiness and alienation? This wise and profound book has provided thousands of readers with an answer—and has helped them to apply it to their own lives.Far too many of us had to learn as children to hide our own feelings, needs, and memories skillfully in order to meet our parents’ expectations and win their ”love.” Alice Miller writes, ”When I used the word ’gifted’ in the title, I had in mind neither children who receive high grades in school nor children talented in a special way. I simply meant all of us who have survived an abusive childhood thanks to an ability to adapt even to unspeakable cruelty by becoming numb… Without this ’gift’ offered us by nature, we would not have survived.” But merely surviving is not enough. The Drama of the Gifted Child helps us to reclaim our life by discovering our own crucial needs and our own truth.

title: After Theory
description: As heralded everywhere from NPR to the pages of the New York Times Magazine, a new era is underway in our colleges and universities: after a lengthy tenure, the dominance of postmodern theory has come to an end. In this timely and topical book, the legendary Terry Eagleton ("one of [our] best-known public intellectuals."-Boston Globe) traces the rise and fall of these ideas from the 1960s through the 1990s, candidly assessing the resultant gains and losses. What's needed now, After Theory argues, is a return to the big questions and grand narratives. Today's global politics demand we pay attention to a range of topics that have gone ignored by the academy and public alike, from fundamentalism to objectivity, religion to ethics. Fresh, provocative, and consistently engaging, Eagleton's latest salvo will challenge everyone looking to better grasp the state of the world.

title: Knowledge And Decisions
description: With a new preface by the author, this reissue of Thomas Sowell's classic study of decision making updates his seminal work in the context of The Vision of the Annointed, Sowell, one of America's most celebrated public intellectuals, describes in concrete detail how knowledge is shared and disseminated throughout modern society. He warns that society suffers from an ever-widening gap between firsthand knowledge and decision making—a gap that threatens not only our economic and political efficiency, but our very freedom because actual knowledge gets replaced by assumptions based on an abstract and elitist social vision f what ought to be.Knowledge and Decisions, a winner of the 1980 Law and Economics Center Prize, was heralded as a ”landmark work” and selected for this prize ”because of its cogent contribution to our understanding of the differences between the market process and the process of government.” In announcing the award, the center acclaimed Sowell, whose ”contribution to our understanding of the process of regulation alone would make the book important, but in reemphasizing the diversity and efficiency that the market makes possible, [his] work goes deeper and becomes even more significant.”

title: Philosophy In The Flesh
description: What are human beings like? How is knowledge possible? What is truth? Where do moral values come from? Questions like these have stood at the center of Western philosophy for centuries. In addressing them, philosophers have made certain fundamental assumptions-that we can know our own minds by introspection, that most of our thinking about the world is literal, and that reason is disembodied and universal-that are now called into question by well-established results of cognitive science. It has been shown empirically that:Most thought is unconscious. We have no direct conscious access to the mechanisms of thought and language. Our ideas go by too quickly and at too deep a level for us to observe them in any simple way.Abstract concepts are mostly metaphorical. Much of the subject matter of philosopy, such as the nature of time, morality, causation, the mind, and the self, relies heavily on basic metaphors derived from bodily experience. What is literal in our reasoning about such concepts is minimal and conceptually impoverished. All the richness comes from metaphor. For instance, we have two mutually incompatible metaphors for time, both of which represent it as movement through space: in one it is a flow past us and in the other a spatial dimension we move along.Mind is embodied. Thought requires a body-not in the trivial sense that you need a physical brain to think with, but in the profound sense that the very structure of our thoughts comes from the nature of the body. Nearly all of our unconscious metaphors are based on common bodily experiences.Most of the central themes of the Western philosophical tradition are called into question by these findings. The Cartesian person, with a mind wholly separate from the body, does not exist. The Kantian person, capable of moral action according to the dictates of a universal reason, does not exist. The phenomenological person, capable of knowing his or her mind entirely through introspection alone, does not exist. The utilitarian person, the Chomskian person, the poststructuralist person, the computational person, and the person defined by analytic philosopy all do not exist.Then what does?Lakoff and Johnson show that a philosopy responsible to the science of mind offers radically new and detailed understandings of what a person is. After first describing the philosophical stance that must follow from taking cognitive science seriously, they re-examine the basic concepts of the mind, time, causation, morality, and the self: then they rethink a host of philosophical traditions, from the classical Greeks through Kantian morality through modern analytic philosopy. They reveal the metaphorical structure underlying each mode of thought and show how the metaphysics of each theory flows from its metaphors. Finally, they take on two major issues of twentieth-century philosopy: how we conceive rationality, and how we conceive language.

spanish_description: ¿Cómo son los seres humanos? ¿Cómo es posible el conocimiento? ¿Qué es la verdad? ¿De dónde provienen los valores morales? Preguntas como estas han sido centrales en la filosofía occidental durante siglos. Al abordarlas, los filósofos han hecho ciertas suposiciones fundamentales —que podemos conocer nuestras propias mentes mediante la introspección, que la mayor parte de nuestro pensamiento sobre el mundo es literal y que la razón es incorpórea y universal— que ahora son cuestionadas por resultados bien establecidos de la ciencia cognitiva. Se ha demostrado empíricamente que: la mayor parte del pensamiento es inconsciente. No tenemos acceso consciente directo a los mecanismos del pensamiento y el lenguaje. Nuestras ideas fluyen demasiado rápido y a un nivel demasiado profundo como para que podamos observarlas de forma sencilla. Los conceptos abstractos son mayormente metafóricos. Gran parte del contenido de la filosofía, como la naturaleza del tiempo, la moral, la causalidad, la mente y el yo, se basa en gran medida en metáforas básicas derivadas de la experiencia corporal. Lo literal en nuestro razonamiento sobre tales conceptos es mínimo y conceptualmente pobre. Toda la riqueza proviene de la metáfora. Por ejemplo, tenemos dos metáforas mutuamente incompatibles para el tiempo, que lo representan como movimiento a través del espacio: en una, es un flujo que nos rodea y en la otra, una dimensión espacial a lo largo de la cual nos movemos. La mente está encarnada. El pensamiento requiere un cuerpo, no en el sentido trivial de que se necesita un cerebro físico para pensar, sino en el sentido profundo de que la estructura misma de nuestros pensamientos proviene de la naturaleza del cuerpo. Casi todas nuestras metáforas inconscientes se basan en experiencias corporales comunes. La mayoría de los temas centrales de la tradición filosófica occidental se ven cuestionados por estos hallazgos. La persona cartesiana, con una mente completamente separada del cuerpo, no existe. La persona kantiana, capaz de actuar moralmente según los dictados de una razón universal, no existe. La persona fenomenológica, capaz de conocer su mente completamente a través de la introspección, no existe. La persona utilitaria, la persona chomskiana, la persona postestructuralista, la persona computacional y la persona definida por la filosofía analítica no existen. ¿Qué existe entonces? Lakoff y Johnson demuestran que una filosofía responsable con la ciencia de la mente ofrece una comprensión radicalmente nueva y detallada de lo que es una persona. Tras describir la postura filosófica que debe seguirse al tomar en serio la ciencia cognitiva, reexaminan los conceptos básicos de mente, tiempo, causalidad, moralidad y el yo. A continuación, replantean diversas tradiciones filosóficas, desde la Grecia clásica hasta la moral kantiana y la filosofía analítica moderna. Revelan la estructura metafórica subyacente a cada modo de pensamiento y muestran cómo la metafísica de cada teoría se deriva de sus metáforas. Finalmente, abordan dos cuestiones fundamentales de la filosofía del siglo XX: cómo concebimos la racionalidad y cómo concebimos el lenguaje.

title: A Conflict Of Visions
description: Controversies in politics arise from many sources, but the conflicts that endure for generations or centuries show a remarkably consistent pattern. In this classic work, Thomas Sowell analyzes this pattern. He describes the two competing visions that shape our debates about the nature of reason, justice, equality, and power: the "constrained" vision, which sees human nature as unchanging and selfish, and the "unconstrained" vision, in which human nature is malleable and perfectible. A Conflict of Visions offers a convincing case that ethical and policy disputes circle around the disparity between both outlooks.

title: Stephen Hawking's Universe
description: Stephen Hawking's A Brief History of Time has sold over 9 million copies worldwide. Now, in everyday language, Stephen Hawking's Universe reveals step-by-step how we can all share his understanding of the cosmos, and our own place within it. Stargazing has never been the same since cosmologists discovered that galaxies are moving away from each other at an extraordinary speed. It was this understanding of the movement of galaxies that allowed scientists to develop a theory of how the universe was created—the Big Bang theory. Working with this theory, Stephen Hawking and other physicists felt challenged to come up with a scientific picture that would tackle the fundamental question: what is the nature of the universe? Stephen Hawking's Universe charts this work and provides simple explanations for phenomena that arouse our curiosity. This work is a voyage of discovery with an astonishing set of conclusions that will enable us to understand how matter can be produced from nothing at all and will provide us with an explanation for the basis of our existence and that of everything around us.

title: Crash Proof
description: The economic tipping point for the United States is no longer theoretical. It is a reality today. The country has gone from the world's largest creditor to its greatest debtor; the value of the dollar is sinking; domestic manufacturing is winding down - and these trends don't seem to be slowing. Peter Schiff casts a sharp, clear-sighted eye on these factors and explains what the possible effects may be and how investors can protect themselves. For more than a decade, Schiff has not only observed the U.S. economy, but also helped his clients reposition their portfolios to reflect his outlook. What he sees is a nation facing an economic storm brought on by growing federal, personal, and corporate debt, too-little savings, a declining dollar, and lack of domestic manufacturing. Crash-Proof is an informed and informative warning of a looming period marked by sizeable tax hikes, loss of retirement benefits, double digit inflation, even - as happened recently in Argentina - the possible collapse of the middle class. However, Schiff does have a survival plan that can provide the protection that readers will need in the coming years.

title: Texas Hold'em For Dummies
description: Turn on the TV, drop by a newsstand, or just browse the checkout your local supermarket and you'll see firsthand that Texas Hold 'Em is the poker game everyone's playing. It's a game that's deceptively simple, yet within its easy framework you’ll find truth and trickery, boredom and fear, skill and misfortune—in other words, all the things that make life fun and worth living! Texas Hold'em For Dummies introduces you to the fundamental concepts and strategies of this wildly popular game. It covers the rules for playing and betting, odds, etiquette, Hold'em lingo, and offers sound advice to avoid mistakes. This handy reference guide gives new and even seasoned players winning strategies and tactics not just for playing the game, but for winning. You'll learn: Rules and strategies for limit, no-limit, tournament, and online play How to "play" the other players The importance of your bankroll—recommended sizes and more Hands you should and should not play How to camouflage your play and dodge traps When, who, and how to bluff How to maximize your win with check-raising and trapping The different approaches for playing in private games, casinos, card rooms, tournaments, and on the Internet How to use mathematics to your advantage Texas Hold 'Em is a game of both skill and chance. But it's a game that can be beaten, and whether you want to make money, sharpen your game, or just have a good time, Texas Hold 'Em for Dummies will give you the winning edge.

title: The Man Who Changed Everything
description: This is the first biography in twenty years of James Clerk Maxwell, one of the greatest scientists of our time and yet a man relatively unknown to the wider public. Approaching science with a freshness unbound by convention or previous expectations, he produced some of the most original scientific thinking of the nineteenth century — and his discoveries went on to shape the twentieth century.

title: Astronomy
description: "A lively, up-to-date account of the basic principles of astronomy and exciting current field of research."-Science Digest For a quarter of a century, Astronomy: A Self-Teaching Guide has been making students and amateur stargazers alike feel at home among the stars. From stars, planets and galaxies, to black holes, the Big Bang and life in space, this title has been making it easy for beginners to quickly grasp the basic concepts of astronomy for over 25 years. Updated with the latest discoveries in astronomy and astrophysics, this newest edition of Dinah Moch?'s classic guide now includes many Web site addresses for spectacular images and news. And like all previous editions, it is packed with valuable tables, charts, star and moon maps and features simple activities that reinforce readers' grasp of basic concepts at their own pace, as well as objectives, reviews, and self-tests to monitor their progress. Dinah L. Moch?, PhD (Rye, NY), is an award-winning author, educator, and lecturer. Her books have sold over nine million copies in seven languages.
